01How It Works · 1 / 18

Payment System

Amazon pe “Buy” dabate hi peeche kya hota hai? Ek payment event banta hai, payment service use save karti hai, payment executor PSP se paise leta hai, wallet seller ka balance update karta hai, aur ledger hisaab likhta hai. Is page me payment system ka poora flow — event se settlement file tak.

1. Payment system matlab ek factory ki assembly line

Socho ek factory hai. Payment service reception hai — order aate hi entry karta hai. Payment executor worker hai — jo actual kaam karta hai (PSP se paise lena). Wallet cashier hai — seller ke paise ka hisaab rakhta hai. Ledger accountant hai — har cheez ka pakka record rakhta hai. Har station ka kaam alag hai — ek ruke to line ruk jati hai, lekin har station alag system hai taaki scale kar sake.

2. Payment flow — step by step

User “Buy” dabata hai — yahan se shuru hota hai.

Event

Step 1–2: Payment event banta hai

User “Buy” dabata hai → ek payment event generate hota hai aur payment service ko bheja jata hai. Payment service event ko database me store karti hai — taaki kuch bhi fail ho to event dobara process ho sake (reliability ke liye).

Kyun store karte hain: agar PSP call fail ho jaye to event dobara retry kar sakte hain — bina event store kiye payment kho jayega.

Executor

Step 3–5: Payment executor paise leta hai

Ek payment event me multiple payment orders ho sakte hain — jaise ek checkout me 3 sellers ke products hon to 3 alag orders. Payment service har payment order ke liye payment executor ko call karti hai.

Payment executor order ko DB me store karta hai, phir external PSP (jaise Stripe, Razorpay) ko call karke credit card payment complete karta hai. PSP hi asli paise card se leta hai.

Wallet

Step 6–7: Wallet update hota hai

Payment executor ke success ke baad, payment service wallet ko call karti hai — seller ka balance update karne ke liye. Wallet server updated balance ko DB me store karta hai.

Wallet kya hai: har seller ka “khata” — kitne paise mile, kitne nikale. Seller apna balance wallet me dekhta hai aur payout le sakta hai.

Ledger

Step 8–9: Ledger me entry

Wallet update ke baad payment service ledger ko call karti hai. Ledger service nayi ledger information ko DB me append karti hai — double-entry bookkeeping (debit buyer, credit seller).

Ledger append-only hai — purani entries kabhi update/delete nahi hoti, sirf nayi judti hain. Isse hisaab hamesha audit kar sakte hain.

Settlement

Step 10: Settlement files — raat ko hisaab

Har raat PSP ya banks settlement files bhejte hain apne clients ko. File me bank account ka balance aur din bhar ke saare transactions hote hain.

Payment system in files ko apne records se reconcile karta hai (Page 179) — koi mismatch ho to break banta hai aur investigation hoti hai.

3. Payment system ke components — ek table me

ComponentKaamDatabase me kya
Payment ServiceEvents receive karna, orchestrate karnaPayment events
Payment ExecutorPSP se payment karwanaPayment orders
PSP (external)Card/bank se paise lena— (bahar ka system)
Wallet ServiceSeller balance track karnaWallet balances
Ledger ServiceDouble-entry hisaabLedger entries (append-only)
// Payment flow — pseudo-code
on BuyButtonClick():
  event = { user_id, items: [...], total: 4999 }
  paymentService.store(event)              // Step 2: event DB me
  for each seller_order in event.splitBySeller():  // Step 3: ek event, kai orders
    executor.execute(seller_order)         // Step 4: order DB me
    psp.charge(card, seller_order.amount)  // Step 5: PSP se paise lo
  wallet.credit(seller_id, amount)         // Step 6-7: seller ka balance
  ledger.append(debit=buyer, credit=seller) // Step 8-9: hisaab likho
// Raat ko: settlement file aayegi -> reconcile karo (Step 10)

Idempotency yaad rakh lo: har payment order ka ek unique ID hota hai — PSP call retry ho to bhi double charge nahi hota (Page 187).

4. Try karo — payment system simulator

Ek checkout chalao — dekho payment event kaise 3 sellers ke orders me bat-ta hai aur har component kya karta hai.

  1. Single seller: 1 product, ₹999
  2. Multi seller: 3 sellers, ₹4,999
  3. PSP fail: card decline
  4. ▶ Run

5. Payment system design ke principles

PrincipleKaise
ReliabilityEvents DB me store karo — fail ho to retry karo
IdempotencyHar order ka unique ID — double charge nahi
AuditabilityLedger append-only — purana hisaab kabhi mat badlo
SeparationWallet aur ledger alag — ek balance, ek hisaab
ReconciliationRaat ko settlement files se milao

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

1. Payment event ko DB me store kiye bina process karna — crash ho to payment kho jayega. Pehle store karo, phir process karo.
2. Wallet aur ledger ko ek hi samajhna — wallet balance hai (kitna hai), ledger history hai (kya hua). Dono alag systems hain.
3. Ledger entries ko update/delete karna — ledger append-only hota hai. Galti ho to nayi correcting entry daalo, purani mat badlo.
4. Multi-seller order ko ek payment samajhna — har seller ka alag order, alag PSP call, alag wallet update hota hai.
5. Settlement files ko reconcile na karna — PSP ke hisaab aur tumhare hisaab me fark ho to paise atak jayenge. Roz reconcile karo.

7. Interview corner

Q: ““Payment system ka flow kya hai?””
A: User Buy dabata hai → payment event banta hai aur payment service use DB me store karti hai → event payment orders me bat-ta hai (har seller ka alag) → payment executor har order ke liye PSP se paise leta hai → wallet seller ka balance update karta hai → ledger me double-entry likhi jati hai → raat ko settlement files se reconcile hota hai. Q: ““Wallet aur ledger me kya farak hai?””
A: Wallet current balance batata hai — seller ke paas abhi kitne paise hain. Ledger history batata hai — kab kya hua, kisne kisko kitna diya. Wallet ek number hai, ledger ek kitaab hai. Dono alag systems hain — wallet fast reads ke liye, ledger audit ke liye. Q: ““Payment event ko pehle DB me kyun store karte ho?””
A: Reliability ke liye. Agar PSP call ke beech system crash ho jaye to event DB me hai — dobara process kar sakte hain. Bina store kiye payment kho jayega — user ko paise katenge ya nahi, ye pata hi nahi chalega.

8. Quick check

  • Event ko 3 payment orders me baant ke har ek ke liye alag PSP call karega — sahi jawab
  • Ek hi payment se 3 sellers ko paise de dega
  • Sirf pehle seller ko paise dega
  • Nayi correcting entry append karo — purani entry kabhi update/delete mat karo — sahi jawab
  • Purani entry ko edit kar do
  • Ledger ko delete karke dobara banao
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: Payment system ek assembly line hai: event store karo, orders me baanto, PSP se paise lo, wallet me balance badhao, ledger me hisaab likho, aur raat ko settlement file se milao. Ledger append-only hai — purana hisaab kabhi mat badlo.

02How It Works · 2 / 18

How do AirTags work?

Tumhari chabhi kho gayi, par uspe laga AirTag ab bhi mil jaata hai — bina GPS, bina SIM, bina internet ke! AirTag ka raaz hai Bluetooth + Apple ke arabon devices ka network: aas-paas se guzarta har iPhone tumhare AirTag ki location chup-chaap Apple tak pahuncha deta hai.

1. How do AirTags work? — pehle ek simple kahani

Socho tumne apne bachche ki jeb me ek chhota seeti wala khilona daal diya. Wo khud kuch nahi bolta, bas halki seeti bajata rehta hai. Aas-paas se guzarne wala har aadmi wo seeti sunke tumhe message kar deta hai — “tumhara bachcha yahan hai.” AirTag bhi wahi seeti hai, aur har iPhone wahi aadmi hai.

2. Gehrai me — tabs me samjho

1. Bluetooth beacon — seeti bajana

AirTag har 2 second me ek Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) signal broadcast karta hai — ek rotating public key ke saath. Is signal ki range ~10 meter hoti hai. AirTag me GPS nahi, Wi-Fi nahi, SIM nahi — sirf ek chhota coin cell (CR2032) jo 1 saal chalta hai, kyunki BLE bahut kam bijli khata hai.

Example: tumhara bag airport pe kho gaya — AirTag bas BLE seeti baja raha hai, koi sunne wala chahiye.

Sahi design: BLE hi kyun? GPS battery kha jaata, aur indoor kaam nahi karta.
Galat soch: “AirTag me GPS hai” — nahi hai, yehi iski cleverness hai.

2. Find My network — arabon jasus

Jab koi iPhone/iPad/Mac AirTag ke BLE range me aata hai, wo signal ko anonymously aur encrypted tareeke se Apple ke servers tak pahuncha deta hai — us iPhone wale ko pata bhi nahi chalta, aur uska data bhi use nahi hota. Ye hai crowdsourced location: jitne zyada Apple devices, utni behtar tracking.

Example: Delhi metro me tumhara bag — har coach me 20 iPhones, location har minute update.

Sahi: relay karne wale ki identity aur location dono private rehti hain.
Galat: sunsaan jagah jahan koi iPhone na aaye — AirTag wahan andha hai.

3. Privacy aur encryption

AirTag ki BLE key har 15 minute me badal jaati hai (rotating identifier) — koi tumhe track nahi kar sakta. Location end-to-end encrypted hai — sirf tum (tumhara iPhone) use decrypt kar sakta hai, Apple bhi nahi. Aur agar kisi aur ka AirTag tumhare saath ghum raha hai to tumhara iPhone alert karta hai — anti-stalking feature.

Example: kisi ne tumhare bag me AirTag chhupaya to kuch ghanton me tumhara iPhone bol dega — “Unknown AirTag tumhare saath chal raha hai.”

Sahi: privacy design me pehle se hai, baad me joda gaya patch nahi.
Galat: AirTag ko bachche ya pet pe tracker samajhna — wo real-time tracking ke liye nahi bana.

4. Precision Finding — aakhri meter

Paas aa jaao (10 meter ke andar) to iPhone ka U1 chip (Ultra Wideband) AirTag se baat karta hai — direction aur distance (jaise “2 meter, left”) dikhata hai, AR arrow ke saath. Yehi Precision Finding hai. Door ho to sirf map pe approx location, paas ho to exact jagah.

Example: sofa ke neeche chabhi — map bolega “ghar pe hai”, Precision Finding bolega “sofa ke peeche, 1 meter.”

Sahi: UWB sirf paas ke liye — battery aur range dono balanced.
Galat: UWB ko GPS samajhna — ye indoor, short-range tech hai.

3. Aur gehrai me — details, numbers aur code

AirTag ka safar — step by step

StepKya hota haiTech
1. BeaconAirTag har 2 sec BLE signal bhejta haiBluetooth Low Energy
2. DetectPaas se guzarta iPhone signal pakadta haiFind My network
3. RelayiPhone location ko encrypted Apple ko bhejta haiEnd-to-end encryption
4. ShowTumhara iPhone Find My app me location dikhata haiiCloud
5. Paas aaoU1 chip se direction + distanceUltra Wideband

Limitations — sach bhi jaano

Real-time tracking NAHI: location tabhi update hoti hai
  jab koi Apple device paas se guzre.
Android pe: sirf 'Tracker Detect' app se manual scan.
Battery: CR2032, ~1 saal, phir replace karo.
Range: BLE ~10m, UWB ~10m — isse zyada nahi.

4. Try karo — khoya hua bag dhoondho

Tumhara bag airport pe kho gaya hai. Neeche steps dabao — dekho AirTag kaise milta hai, step by step.

  1. 1. Bag kho gaya!
  2. 2. Koi iPhone paas se guzra
  3. 3. Tum wapas airport gaye
  4. 4. Sunsaan jagah — AirTag fail

5. Comparison — ek table me

AirTagGPS tracker (SIM wala)
Location kaisePaas ke iPhones seGPS satellite + SIM data
Battery~1 saal (coin cell)Kuch din (charge karna padta)
Monthly cost₹0SIM plan chahiye
Real-time?Nahi — jab koi paas aayeHaan, continuous
Best forBag, chabhi, walletGaadi, pet, bachche

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

  • AirTag ko GPS tracker samajhna — real-time location nahi deta.
  • Sunsaan jagah pe bharosa karna — network bina, AirTag andha hai.
  • Anti-stalking alert ignore karna — unknown AirTag ka alert serious hai.
  • Battery check na karna — 1 saal baad cell badlo, nahi to seeti band.
  • AirTag ko bachche pe lagana — ye uske liye design nahi hua, na real-time hai.

7. Interview corner

AirTag bina GPS ke location kaise deta hai?

AirTag BLE beacon bhejta hai, paas se guzarta Apple device use detect karke encrypted location Apple ko relay karta hai. Ye crowdsourced Find My network hai — GPS AirTag me nahi, relay karne wale phone me hota hai.

AirTag ki privacy kaise bachi rehti hai?

BLE identifier har 15 min me rotate hota hai, location end-to-end encrypted hai (sirf owner decrypt kar sakta hai), aur relay karne wale ki identity kabhi share nahi hoti.

Precision Finding kya hai?

Paas (10m) aane pe iPhone ka U1 Ultra Wideband chip AirTag se direction aur distance nikaalta hai aur AR arrow dikhata hai — map ki approx location se exact jagah tak le jaata hai.

8. Quick check

Q1. AirTag me location kaise pata chalti hai — usme kya nahi hota?

  • GPS chip
  • GPS nahi hota — paas ke Apple devices BLE signal relay karte hain — sahi jawab
  • SIM card se

Q2. AirTag ki battery kitni chalti hai aur kyun itni lambi?

  • 1 hafta, GPS ki wajah se
  • ~1 saal, kyunki sirf Bluetooth Low Energy use karta hai — sahi jawab
  • Hamesha, solar se
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: AirTag khud kuch nahi dhoondhta — wo bas BLE seeti bajata hai, aur duniya bhar ke iPhones uski awaaz tum tak pahuncha dete hain.

03How It Works · 3 / 18

How is Email Delivered?

Tum “Send” dabate ho, aur 2 second me email doosre desh me pahunch jaata hai. Peeche ek poora relay race chalti hai: SMTP, DNS, mail servers, IMAP — har runner email ko agle tak pahuncha deta hai. Ye page usi race ka step-by-step tour hai.

1. How is Email Delivered? — pehle ek simple kahani

Email bhejna ek khat bhejne jaisa hai — tum khat postbox me daalte ho (SMTP), post office pata dhoondhta hai (DNS), khat sheher badalta hai (mail servers ke beech SMTP), aur aakhir me paane wale ke postbox me padta hai (mailbox), jahan se wo use nikaal ke padhta hai (IMAP). Bas ye sab 2 second me hota hai.

2. Gehrai me — tabs me samjho

1. SMTP — bhejne ka protocol

SMTP (Simple Mail Transfer Protocol) email bhejne ke liye hai — client se server, aur server se server. Tumhara mail app (Outlook/Gmail) email ko tumhare provider ke SMTP server ko deta hai. SMTP sirf bhejta hai, inbox se nikaal ke padhna iska kaam nahi.

Example: Sender Outlook se Receiver ko mail bhejti hai — pehle hop Outlook SMTP server tak hai.

Sahi: SMTP = send karne ka protocol, yaad rakhne ka shortcut hai.
Galat: SMTP se email padhne ki koshish — wo IMAP/POP ka kaam hai.

2. DNS — pata dhoondhna

Mail server ko pata karna hota hai ki bob@gmail.com ka mail kahan bhejna hai. Wo DNS MX record poochhta hai — “gmail.com ka mail server kaun hai?” Jawab milta hai: gmail-smtp-in.l.google.com. Bina DNS ke email kahin nahi ja sakta.

Example: MX record galat ho to mail wapas aata hai — “address not found” bounce.

Sahi: MX record = domain ka mail server ka pata.
Galat: A record se mail server dhoondhna — A record website ka pata hai, mail ka nahi.

3. Server-to-server relay

Tumhara SMTP server ab Gmail ke SMTP server se SMTP handshake karta hai (EHLO → MAIL FROM → RCPT TO → DATA), email transfer karta hai, aur Gmail use apne mailbox storage me rakh leta hai. Beech me spam filter aur DKIM/SPF check hota hai — farzi sender ka mail yahin pakda jaata hai.

Example: SPF fail ho to Gmail mail ko spam me daal deta hai ya reject kar deta hai.

Sahi: SPF + DKIM + DMARC — teeno milke email ko authentic banate hain.
Galat: bina authentication ke khula SMTP server — spammers ka favourite (open relay).

4. IMAP/POP — email padhna

Receiver jab Gmail kholta hai, uska client IMAP se server se emails fetch karta hai — mail server pe hi rehta hai, har device pe sync hota hai (phone pe padha to laptop pe bhi read dikhega). POP3 purana hai — mail download karke server se delete kar deta hai, ek hi device ke liye.

Example: phone + laptop dono pe Gmail chalana hai to IMAP hi chahiye.

Sahi: aaj IMAP standard hai — multi-device sync ke liye.
Galat: POP use karke hairan hona ki laptop pe mail kyun nahi dikh raha.

3. Aur gehrai me — details, numbers aur code

Email ka safar — Sender se Receiver tak

StepKya hota haiProtocol
1Sender mail likh ke Send dabati haiMail client
2Mail Outlook SMTP server ko milta haiSMTP
3Outlook server DNS se gmail.com ka MX dhoondhta haiDNS (MX)
4Mail Gmail SMTP server ko transfer hota haiSMTP
5Gmail spam/DKIM check karke mailbox me store karta haiSPF/DKIM
6Receiver IMAP se mail fetch karke padhta haiIMAP

Protocols — ek line me

SMTP  (port 25/587) : bhejne ke liye
IMAP  (port 993)    : padhne ke liye, server pe sync
POP3  (port 995)    : padhne ke liye, download + delete
SPF   : ye server is domain se bhej sakta hai?
DKIM  : mail pe digital signature — chhed-chhaad pakdo
DMARC : SPF/DKIM fail ho to kya karo?

4. Try karo — ek email ka safar, step by step

Sender Receiver ko email bhejti hai. Har step dabao aur dekho email kahan se kahan jaata hai — aur kahan atak sakta hai.

  1. 1. Sender Send dabati hai
  2. 2. DNS — Gmail ka pata dhoondho
  3. 3. Server se server transfer
  4. 4. Receiver mail padhta hai
  5. 5. Galat sender — spam me!

5. Comparison — ek table me

ProtocolKaamMail kahan rehta hai
SMTPBhejna—
IMAPPadhna + syncServer pe
POP3Padhna + downloadDevice pe (server se delete)

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

  • SMTP se mail padhne ki koshish — SMTP sirf bhejta hai.
  • MX record bhoolna — domain liya, website chal gayi, mail nahi aa raha kyunki MX hi nahi hai.
  • SPF/DKIM na lagana — tumhare mails spam me jaayenge.
  • POP use karke multi-device expect karna — POP ek device ka protocol hai.
  • Open relay chhodna — tumhara server spammers ka free service ban jaata hai.

7. Interview corner

Email bhejne me kaunse protocols use hote hain?

Bhejne ke liye SMTP (client→server aur server→server), padhne ke liye IMAP (ya purana POP3). Beech me DNS MX record se recipient ka mail server dhoondha jaata hai.

SPF, DKIM, DMARC kya hain?

Teeno email authentication hain: SPF batata hai kaunsa server bhej sakta hai, DKIM mail pe digital signature lagata hai, DMARC batata hai fail hone pe kya karna hai — ye milke spam aur phishing rokte hain.

IMAP vs POP3?

IMAP mail server pe rakhta hai aur har device pe sync karta hai. POP3 download karke server se delete kar deta hai — ek hi device ke liye tha, aaj outdated hai.

Guide se — MUA, MTA, MDA (exact terms)

Email bilkul snail mail jaisa hai — postcard, mailbox, post office, dost ka mailbox. Email me wahi kaam, sirf terms badal jaate hain, kyunki ye internet-based solution hai:

  • MUA (Mail User Agent) — Outlook ya Gmail jaisa client. Sender email ko Sender Mail Server pe push karta hai — mailbox me daalne ke bajay.
  • MTA (Mail Transmission Agent) — email ko relay karta hai, post office ki tarah. SMTP protocol se baat karta hai.
  • MDA (Mail Delivery Agent) — Receiver Mail Server pe email ko Mailbox me store karta hai. Receiver apne MUA se POP3/IMAP protocol se email retrieve karta hai.

Matlab: MUA bhejte waqt, MTA raaste me, MDA pahunchne par — teeno ke naam aur kaam yaad rakhna, interview me yehi poochha jaata hai.

8. Quick check

Q1. Email bhejne (send karne) ke liye kaunsa protocol use hota hai?

  • IMAP
  • SMTP — sahi jawab
  • POP3

Q2. gmail.com ka mail server kaise pata chalta hai?

  • A record se
  • DNS MX record se — sahi jawab
  • Guess karke
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: SMTP bhejta hai, DNS MX se pata dhoondhta hai, server-to-server relay karta hai, aur IMAP se tum mail padhte ho — yehi email ka poora safar hai.

04How It Works · 4 / 18

Design Gmail

Gmail design karna matlab sirf “email bhejna” nahi — matlab hai 1.8 billion users, har din 300 billion emails, search jo second me ho, spam jo kabhi inbox na aaye, aur attachment jo kabhi khoye nahi. Ye page Gmail ko system design interview ki nazar se kholta hai.

1. Design Gmail — pehle ek simple kahani

Gmail ek bahut badi dak-ghar (post office) hai — roz arabon khat aate hain. Har khat ko sahi dibbe (inbox) me daalna, har khat pe pata likhna (indexing) taaki 2 second me dhoondh sako, aur kachra khat (spam) ko alag rakhna — yehi Gmail ka kaam hai. Sirf fark ye hai ki dakiya yahan algorithms hain.

2. Gehrai me — tabs me samjho

1. Requirements — kitna bada?

Scale: ~1.8B users, ~300B emails/day, har user ko 15GB free storage. Functional: send/receive, search, labels, attachments, spam filter. Non-functional: search < 1 sec, 99.9% availability, koi mail kabhi lose nahi hona chahiye (durability 11 nines jaisi).

Estimate: 300B/day ≈ 3.5M emails/sec peak — aur har email ko store + index karna hai.

Sahi: interview me pehle numbers bolo — scale se hi architecture decide hoti hai.
Galat: “MySQL me ek emails table” — 300B rows ek table me nahi jaati.

2. Send ka flow — SMTP se storage tak

Send: client → SMTP server → DNS MX se recipient server → recipient ke mailbox storage (distributed object store, jaise Colossus/GFS). Email sharded hota hai userId ke hisaab se. Har email ke saath metadata (sender, subject, labels) alag store hoti hai taaki list fast dikhe.

Example: Sender Receiver ko mail bhejti hai — Sender ka SMTP, DNS, Receiver ka Gmail server, phir Receiver ke shard me store.

Sahi: metadata aur body alag — inbox list ke liye body load karne ki zaroorat nahi.
Galat: poora email ek hi row me — list kholte hi GBs load honge.

3. Search — 2 second me kaise?

Gmail search inverted index pe chalta hai — har word → kaunse emails me hai. Index sharded hota hai user ke hisaab se, aur incremental update hota hai (naya mail aate hi index update). Isi liye “from:boss invoice” turant result deta hai — poora mailbox scan nahi hota.

Example: 10 saal ke 100,000 emails me “flight ticket” dhoondhna — index ke bina minutes, index se milliseconds.

Sahi: per-user sharded inverted index — search ka raaz.
Galat: SQL LIKE '%ticket%' — full scan, kabhi scale nahi hoga.

4. Spam, attachments, storage

Spam: ML models har mail ko score karte hain (sender reputation, content, user reports) — 99.9% spam inbox tak pahunchta hi nahi. Attachments: object storage me, deduplicated (10 logon ko same file mili to ek hi copy). Storage: 15GB quota, purana data cheap storage pe.

Example: ek viral meme 1M logon ko mila — dedup ki wajah se ek hi copy store hui.

Sahi: dedup + tiered storage — cost ka 80% yahin bachta hai.
Galat: har attachment ki alag copy — storage bill phat jayega.

3. Aur gehrai me — details, numbers aur code

Gmail architecture — blocks

BlockKaamTech
SMTP serversSend/receiveSMTP, MX routing
Mailbox storageEmail body + metadataDistributed store, userId shard
Search indexFast searchInverted index, per-user shard
Spam filterSpam roknaML models, reputation
Attachment storeFilesObject store + dedup
Push/notifyNaya mail batanaPush notification, IMAP IDLE

Storage estimate

300B emails/day, average 50KB (body + attachment)
= 15 PB/day raw! (dedup + compression se kam)
Per user: 15GB quota, average use ~2-3GB
Isliye: dedup, compression, tiered storage —
  bina inke Gmail chal hi nahi sakta.

4. Try karo — ek email ka Gmail ke andar ka safar

Sender Receiver ko email bhejti hai. Har step dabao — dekho Gmail ke andar kya-kya hota hai: spam check se lekar search index tak.

  1. 1. Sender Send dabati hai
  2. 2. Spam check
  3. 3. Store + index
  4. 4. Receiver ko notification

5. Comparison — ek table me

FeatureKaise (Gmail scale pe)Chhota system me
StorageSharded distributed storeEk MySQL table
SearchInverted indexSQL LIKE
SpamML modelsSimple rules
AttachmentsDedup + object storeServer ki disk

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

  • Ek table me saare emails — sharding bina 300B rows impossible.
  • Search ke liye LIKE use karna — inverted index hi ek raasta hai.
  • Body aur metadata ek saath — inbox list slow ho jaayegi.
  • Spam ko baad me sochna — spam filter core feature hai, add-on nahi.
  • Dedup bhoolna — attachments ka storage bill sabse bada kharcha hai.

7. Interview corner

Gmail me search itni fast kaise hoti hai?

Inverted index se — har word se kaunse emails jude hain, ye pehle se index hota hai, per-user shard me. Search karte waqt poora mailbox scan nahi hota, sirf index lookup hota hai.

Attachments ka storage kaise manage hota hai?

Object storage me, deduplication ke saath — same file kai logon ko mili to ek hi copy store hoti hai. Plus compression aur tiered storage (purana data saste storage pe).

Email kabhi lose kyun nahi hota?

Replication + durable distributed storage — har email kai copies me alag machines pe store hota hai. Ek machine mare to bhi data safe rehta hai.

Guide ka exact flow — Sending an Email: A Step-by-Step Guide (Sender se Receiver tak)

Ek picture hazaar shabdon ke barabar hai — dekho Sender Receiver ko email bhejti hai to kya hota hai:

  1. Sender Outlook client me login karke email likhti hai aur Send dabati hai. Email Outlook mail server ko jaata hai. Client aur mail server ke beech ka protocol SMTP hai.
  2. Outlook mail server DNS query karke recipient ke SMTP server ka address dhoondhta hai — yahan Gmail ka SMTP server. Phir email Gmail mail server ko transfer hota hai. Mail servers ke beech ka protocol bhi SMTP hai.
  3. Gmail server email store karta hai aur Receiver ke liye available kar deta hai.
  4. Receiver login karta hai to Gmail client IMAP/POP server se naye emails fetch karta hai — POP3 bhi yahi kaam karta hai, IMAP ke saath.

8. Quick check

Q1. Gmail me 100,000 emails me search fast kaise hoti hai?

  • Har baar saare emails scan karke
  • Inverted index — har word se emails ka pehle se bana index — sahi jawab
  • Cache me saare emails rakh ke

Q2. Same attachment 1M logon ko mila — storage kaise bachta hai?

  • Har user ke liye alag copy
  • Deduplication — ek hi copy store hoti hai — sahi jawab
  • Attachment delete kar dete hain
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: Gmail ka raaz: sharded storage, inverted index search, ML spam filter aur dedup — scale pe har cheez ka ek clever jawab hai.

05How It Works · 5 / 18

How Google/Apple Maps Blur License Plates and Faces

Google Street View pe kabhi apna ghar dekha hai? Tumhara chehra aur gaadi ki number plate blur hoti hai — automatic! Ye kaam karta hai computer vision pipeline: pehle photo me chehre aur plates dhoondho, phir unhe blur karo, phir publish karo. Privacy, scale pe, automatic.

1. How Google/Apple Maps Blur License Plates and Faces — pehle ek simple kahani

Socho ek newspaper me hazaaron photo chhapni hain, aur har photo me kisi ka chehra dhakna hai — haath se impossible. Isliye ek smart machine pehle har photo ko dekhti hai, chehre pe ungli rakhti hai, aur wahan kaala dabba laga deti hai. Street View ka blur system wahi machine hai — bas photos arabon hain.

2. Gehrai me — tabs me samjho

1. Capture — photo kaise aati hai

Street View gaadiyon pe 360° cameras (15 lenses) lage hote hain, har kuch meter pe photo lete hain. Ek sheher ki drive se lakhs of panoramas bante hain. Har panorama ke saath GPS + gyroscope data bhi record hota hai — photo kahan ki hai, ye pata chale.

Example: ek gaadi din bhar chale to 10,000+ panoramas — har ek ko blur karna hai.

Sahi: capture ke time hi location metadata jod do — baad me dhoondhna aasan.
Galat: sirf photo rakhna, location alag se guess karna.

2. Detection — chehra aur plate dhoondho

Object detection models (CNN-based, jaise face detection + OCR/plate detection) har panorama ko scan karte hain. Model bounding boxes banata hai — “yahan chehra hai, yahan plate hai.” Recall zyada important hai precision se — ek chehra chhoot gaya to privacy leak, galat blur ho to sirf thoda ajeeb lagega.

Example: bheed wali sadak pe 50 chehre — model ko sab dhoondhne hain, ek bhi miss nahi.

Sahi: high recall tune karo — miss hone se behtar hai extra blur ho.
Galat: sirf saamne wale chehre detect karna — side wale, chhote, aadhe dhake chehre bhi count hote hain.

3. Blur — kaise dhaka jaata hai

Detection ke baad bounding box pe Gaussian blur lagta hai — pixels ko mila do, pehchan khatam. Blur panorama pe permanent hota hai (original bhi Google ke andar restricted rehta hai). User blur request bhi kar sakta hai — “mera ghar blur karo” — to manual review ke baad extra blur lagta hai.

Example: tumhara ghar dikh raha ho to “Report a problem” se blur request kar sakte ho.

Sahi: blur publish se pehle, pipeline me hi lagao.
Galat: blur ko reversible rakhna — phir privacy ka matlab hi kya?

4. Scale aur edge cases

Arabon panoramas — pipeline distributed hai (MapReduce/Dataflow jaisi batch processing), GPU pe models chalte hain. Edge cases: bachche, peeche se dikhte log, reflection (sheeshe me chehra), number plate ka alag-alag desh ka format. Har desh ke privacy laws alag — Europe (GDPR) me zyada strict.

Example: sheeshe wali building me reflection me dikhta chehra bhi blur hona chahiye — model ko ye bhi sikhana padta hai.

Sahi: human review loop — low-confidence detections ko insaan check kare.
Galat: sirf ek desh ke plates pe train karna — baaki deshon me fail.

3. Aur gehrai me — details, numbers aur code

Pipeline — capture se publish tak

StepKaamTech
1. Capture360° photos + GPSMulti-lens camera rig
2. Stitch15 photos → 1 panoramaImage stitching
3. DetectChehre + plates dhoondhoCNN object detection
4. BlurBoxes pe Gaussian blurImage processing
5. ReviewLow-confidence checkHuman-in-the-loop
6. PublishMaps pe dikhaoTile serving + CDN

Recall vs precision — privacy me recall jeetta hai

Precision: jitne blur kiye, kitne sahi the?
Recall:    jitne chehre the, kitne pakde gaye?
Privacy ke liye RECALL 99.9%+ chahiye —
  ek miss = ek insaan ki pehchan leak.
Extra blur (low precision) sirf thoda bura dikhta hai.

4. Try karo — Street View photo ko blur karo

Ek panorama aaya hai. Steps dabao — dekho detection se lekar publish tak kya hota hai, aur kahan galti ho sakti hai.

  1. 1. Photo capture hui
  2. 2. Detection chala
  3. 3. Blur laga
  4. 4. Publish hua
  5. 5. Galti: ek chehra miss ho gaya

5. Comparison — ek table me

ApproachRecallCostKab
ML auto-detect~99%MediumScale pe — main method
Manual review~100%Very highSirf low-confidence cases
Poora photo blur100%LowPhoto hi bekaar ho jaayegi
Kuch na karo0%ZeroPrivacy laws todenge — illegal

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

  • Precision pe focus, recall bhoolna — ek miss hi kaafi hai leak ke liye.
  • Reflection aur side faces ignore karna — model ko har angle sikhana padta hai.
  • Blur ko reversible rakhna — original accessible raha to privacy khatam.
  • Ek desh ke data pe train karna — plates aur chehre har jagah alag dikhte hain.
  • Human review loop na rakhna — low-confidence cases bina review ke publish karna risk hai.

7. Interview corner

Street View blur pipeline kaise design karoge?

Capture → stitch → ML detection (face + plate) → blur → human review for low-confidence → publish. Recall ko precision se zyada priority do, aur pipeline distributed batch processing pe chalao.

Recall vs precision — yahan kaun jeetega?

Recall — ek bhi chehra miss hona privacy leak hai, jabki extra blur sirf cosmetic issue hai. Isliye detection threshold low rakho aur human review loop rakho.

User apna ghar blur karwana chahe to?

Report-a-problem flow — request aate hi manual review, phir extra blur lagake panorama republish. Ye GDPR jaise laws me zaroori bhi hai (right to be forgotten).

Guide ki 3 pipelines — exact steps

High-level architecture 3 stages me banti hai:

  • Data pipeline — training dataset taiyaar karo.
  • Blurring pipeline — objects extract aur classify karo, aur relevant objects (jaise license plates aur faces) blur karo.
  • Serving pipeline — blurred Street View images users ko serve karo.
  1. Step 1: annotated dataset lo — objects bounding boxes me marked hote hain.
  2. Steps 2–4: dataset preprocessing aur augmentation se guzarta hai — normalize aur scale karo.
  3. Steps 5–6: annotated dataset se machine learning model train karo — ye ek 2-stage network hai.
  4. Steps 7–10: Street View images preprocessing se guzarti hain, object boundaries detect hoti hain, sensitive objects blur hote hain, aur images object store me save hoti hain.
  5. Step 11: blurred images ab users retrieve kar sakte hain.

8. Quick check

Q1. Blur pipeline me sabse important metric kaunsi hai?

  • Precision — galat blur na ho
  • Recall — koi chehra ya plate miss na ho — sahi jawab
  • Speed — jaldi publish ho

Q2. Chehra detect hone ke baad uspe kya lagta hai?

  • Kaala dabba permanently
  • Gaussian blur — pixels mila ke pehchan khatam — sahi jawab
  • Kuch nahi, waise hi rehta hai
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: Capture karo, ML se chehre-plates dhoondho, blur karo, aur low-confidence wale insaan se check karwao — privacy scale pe aise hi banti hai.

06How It Works · 6 / 18

Quadtree

Google Maps pe jab tum zoom karte ho, to poori duniya ke arabon locations me se sirf tumhare aas-paas wale restaurants kaise mil jaate hain — second ke fraction me? Jawab hai Quadtree: ek aisa tree jo map ko baar-baar 4 hisso me baant ta hai, jab tak har hisse me sirf kuch locations na bach jaayein.

1. Quadtree — pehle ek simple kahani

Socho ek sheher ka map hai aur tumhe paas ki dukaan dhoondhni hai. Poora sheher ek-ek ghar karke check karoge to din lag jayega. Quadtree pehle sheher ko 4 bade hisso me baant ta hai — tumhara hissa chuno, phir use bhi 4 me baanto — bas 4-5 baar me tum apni gali tak pahunch jaate ho. Har baar 75% sheher ek jhatke me khatam.

2. Gehrai me — tabs me samjho

1. Quadtree hota kya hai?

Quadtree ek spatial tree hai: root node poora map (bounding box) hota hai. Jab ek node me points capacity (jaise 4) se zyada ho jaayein, wo 4 quadrants (NW, NE, SW, SE) me split ho jaata hai. Har point sirf ek leaf me rehta hai. Isse nearby search fast ho jaata hai — sirf aas-paas wale quadrants check karo, poora map nahi.

Example: 10 lakh restaurants, capacity 4 — tree ki depth ~9, search me sirf ~100 nodes check hote hain, 10 lakh nahi.

Sahi: spatial queries (nearby, range, k-nearest) ke liye perfect.
Galat: non-spatial data (jaise usernames) pe quadtree — wahan B-tree/hashmap chahiye.

2. Insert aur split kaise hota hai

Point insert karo: root se shuru karo, jis quadrant me point aata hai usme jao, leaf tak pahunch ke add karo. Leaf full ho (capacity cross) to split karo — 4 children banao, points ko unme baanto. Split lazy hota hai — zaroorat padne pe hi, isliye tree balanced rehta hai jahan data dense hai.

Example: Delhi me restaurants dense hain to wahan tree gehrai tak split hoga; Rajasthan ke registan me ek hi node kaafi.

Sahi: capacity 4-16 ke beech rakho — zyada chhoti to tree bahut gehra, zyada badi to leaf scan slow.
Galat: har insert pe poora tree rebuild karna.

3. Nearby search — k-nearest

Range query: ek rectangle do, tree sirf usse intersect karne wale nodes check karta hai. K-nearest neighbours: point se shuru karo, pehle apna quadrant, phir aas-paas wale — jab tak k neighbours na mil jaayein. Best-first search se distance prune hota hai — door wale quadrants chhode jaate hain.

Example: “Mere 2km ke andar 5 petrol pump” — quadtree sirf 2km wale boxes check karega, poora sheher nahi.

Sahi: k-nearest me priority queue se nodes ko distance ke order me visit karo.
Galat: saare points ki distance nikaal ke sort karna — O(n), quadtree ka fayda khatam.

4. Quadtree vs Geohash vs R-tree

Geohash: location ko ek string me encode karo (jaise u4pruyd) — prefix match se nearby milta hai, simple hai par boundary pe fail hota hai (paas ki jagah alag prefix). R-tree: rectangles ko group karta hai, databases (PostGIS) me use hota hai. Quadtree: simple, in-memory games/maps me best, dynamic split aasan.

Example: Uber nearby drivers ke liye geohash + quadtree dono use karte hain — geohash se sharding, quadtree se exact search.

Sahi: use case dekh ke chunna — DB me R-tree, memory me quadtree, simple key-value me geohash.
Galat: “Ek hi best hai” bolna — har ek ka trade-off hai.

3. Aur gehrai me — details, numbers aur code

Quadtree — complexity

OperationAverageWorst
InsertO(log n)O(n) — saare points ek jagah hon to
Range queryO(k + log n)O(n) — poora map hi range ho to
Nearest neighbourO(log n)O(n)

k = result me points ki sankhya. Worst case tab hota hai jab saare points ek hi chhote area me hon — tree ek taraf gehra ho jaata hai.

Insert ka pseudocode

class QuadNode:
  boundary  # rectangle (x, y, w, h)
  capacity = 4
  points = []
  children = None  # NW, NE, SW, SE
def insert(node, point):
  if not node.boundary.contains(point): return False
  if len(node.points) < capacity and node.children is None:
    node.points.append(point); return True
  if node.children is None: node.subdivide()  # 4 me baanto
  return any(insert(c, point) for c in node.children)

4. Try karo — map ko baanto, nearby dhoondho

Ek map hai, usme restaurants hain. Buttons dabao — dekho quadtree kaise split hota hai aur nearby search poora map scan kiye bina kaise kaam karta hai.

  1. Points insert karo
  2. Nearby search: 2km ke andar restaurants
  3. Dense area — gehra tree
  4. K-nearest: 5 sabse paas ke

5. Comparison — ek table me

MethodBest forWeakness
QuadtreeIn-memory spatial search, gamesSkewed data pe gehra tree
GeohashSimple key-value, shardingBoundary problem
R-treeDatabases (PostGIS)Complex implementation
Brute forceChhota data (< 1000)Bade data pe bahut slow

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

  • Capacity bahut chhoti rakhna — tree bahut gehra, har query me zyada hops.
  • Capacity bahut badi rakhna — leaf me 1000 points, scan slow.
  • Skewed data ignore karna — saare points ek jagah hon to tree unbalanced.
  • Har query pe poora tree traverse karna — pruning hi quadtree ki jaan hai.
  • Spatial data pe hashmap use karna — hashmap ko “paas” ka matlab nahi pata.

7. Interview corner

Quadtree kya hai aur kahan use hota hai?

Ek spatial tree jo 2D space ko baar-baar 4 quadrants me baant ta hai. Nearby search, range queries aur maps/games me use hota hai — Google Maps, Uber jaise systems me.

Geohash vs quadtree?

Geohash location ko string banata hai — simple, sharding me aasan, par boundary pe paas ki jagah alag prefix me aa jaati hai. Quadtree exact spatial search deta hai, par in-memory structure hai.

Quadtree ki worst-case complexity kya hai?

O(n) — jab saare points ek hi chhote area me hon to tree ek taraf gehra ho jaata hai. Average case O(log n) hota hai, isliye capacity aur data distribution matter karte hain.

Guide ke numbers — LBS aur quadtree

  • Quadtree ek in-memory data structure hai — database solution nahi hai. Ye har LBS (Location-Based Service) server pe chalta hai, aur server start-up time pe build hota hai.
  • Root node poora world map hai. Root recursively 4 quadrants me toot-ta hai, jab tak kisi node me 100 se zyada businesses na rahein.

How to get nearby businesses with quadtree?

Quadtree memory me build karo, phir root se traverse karo jab tak search origin wala leaf node na mile. Agar us leaf me 100 businesses hain to wahi return karo — warna neighbours se businesses add karo jab tak kaafi na mil jaayein.

Update LBS server and rebuild quadtree

200 million businesses ke saath quadtree build karne me server start-up pe kuch minutes lagte hain. Build hote waqt server traffic serve nahi kar sakta. Isliye nayi release ko ek saath saare servers pe mat daalo — chhote subset pe incremental rollout karo, warna bada hissa offline hoga aur service brownout hogi.

8. Quick check

Q1. Quadtree me nearby search fast kyun hota hai?

  • Saare points ek saath check karta hai
  • Sirf query se intersect karne wale quadrants check karta hai, baaki skip — sahi jawab
  • Points ko sort karke rakhta hai

Q2. Ek node me capacity se zyada points aa jaayein to kya hota hai?

  • Points delete ho jaate hain
  • Node 4 quadrants me split ho jaata hai — sahi jawab
  • Tree crash ho jaata hai
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: Map ko 4-4 me baant te jao — har baar 75% hissa khatam, aur nearby search second ke fraction me.

← Previous05 · How Google/Apple Maps Blur License Plates and FacesNext →07 · Build a Simple Chat Application with Redis
07How It Works · 7 / 18

Build a Simple Chat Application with Redis

WhatsApp jaisi chat app banana hai? Redis se shuruaat kar sakte ho — ek hi tool se real-time messages, online status, aur chat history teeno mil jaate hain. Ye page dikhata hai kaise: Pub/Sub se live messages, Lists se history, aur Sets se online users.

1. Build a Simple Chat Application with Redis — pehle ek simple kahani

Socho ek mohalle me ek notice board hai (Redis). Koi kuch bolta hai to board pe likh deta hai (publish), aur jo bhi board dekh raha hai use turant dikh jaata hai (subscribe). Purane notices ek register me chipke rehte hain (list), aur kaun mohalle me hai ye ek hazri register me likha hai (set). Bas — yehi chat app hai.

2. Gehrai me — tabs me samjho

1. Pub/Sub — live messages

Redis Pub/Sub: ek channel (jaise chat:room42) pe PUBLISH karo, us channel ke saare SUBSCRIBE kiye hue clients ko turant message mil jaata hai. Ye fire-and-forget hai — jo online hai use milega, jo offline hai use nahi. Isliye Pub/Sub sirf live delivery ke liye hai, history ke liye nahi.

Example: Rahul ne “hi” bheja → PUBLISH chat:room42 → Seema aur Amit (subscribed) ko turant mila.

Sahi: live messages ke liye Pub/Sub — simple aur fast.
Galat: Pub/Sub ko hi history samajhna — offline user ka message kho jaayega.

2. Lists — chat history

Har message ko Redis List me bhi daalo — RPUSH chat:room42:history {msg}. List ordered rehti hai, aur LRANGE se aakhri 50 messages nikaal lo. List ko trim karo (LTRIM 0 99) taaki memory na phate — sirf recent 100 messages Redis me, purana DB me.

Example: Seema app kholti hai → LRANGE se aakhri 50 messages → chat history dikh gayi, phir Pub/Sub se live messages.

Sahi: Redis = recent history (hot), DB = poora archive (cold).
Galat: saari history Redis me — memory bill aasmaan pe.

3. Sets aur Sorted Sets — online status, typing

Set (SADD online_users rahul) se pata chalta hai kaun online hai. Sorted Set se typing indicator ya last seen (score = timestamp). Hash se user profile (name, avatar) store karo. Expiry (TTL) se heartbeat — user har 30 sec me ping kare, TTL 60 sec, ping band = offline.

Example: Rahul type kar raha hai → ZADD typing:room42 timestamp rahul → sabko “Rahul typing…” dikhta hai.

Sahi: presence ke liye TTL + heartbeat — crash hua user apne aap offline ho jaata hai.
Galat: online status DB me — har heartbeat pe DB write, DB marega.

4. Scale — ek Redis se aage

Ek Redis instance ~100k msgs/sec handle kar leta hai. Aage badho to: Redis Cluster (channels sharded), multiple app servers (har server Redis se subscribe kare — koi bhi server kisi bhi user ko message de sakta hai), aur persistent DB (Postgres/Mongo) history ke liye. Offline users ko push notification (FCM/APNs) bhejo.

Example: 1M users — 10 app servers, Redis Cluster, Postgres archive, FCM push.

Sahi: Redis hot path, DB cold path, push offline path — teeno alag.
Galat: ek hi Redis, bina cluster ke, production me — single point of failure.

3. Aur gehrai me — details, numbers aur code

Redis data structures — chat me kya kahan

KaamRedis typeCommands
Live messagePub/SubPUBLISH / SUBSCRIBE
History (recent)ListRPUSH / LRANGE / LTRIM
Online usersSetSADD / SREM / SMEMBERS
Typing / last seenSorted SetZADD / ZRANGE
User profileHashHSET / HGETALL
Unread countHash / counterHINCRBY

Message bhejने ka flow (code jaisa)

# User ne message bheja
redis.rpush('chat:room42:history', msg_json)
redis.ltrim('chat:room42:history', -100, -1)  # sirf 100 rakho
redis.publish('chat:room42', msg_json)         # live walo ko
# Offline users ke liye:
for user in offline_members:
    send_push_notification(user, msg_json)

4. Try karo — chat room chalao

Ek chat room hai: Rahul, Seema, Amit. Buttons dabao — message bhejo, kisi ko offline karo, history dekho. Log me dekho Redis ke andar kya hota hai.

  1. Rahul: 'Hi sab!' bhejta hai
  2. Amit offline ho gaya
  3. Seema typing kar rahi hai
  4. Naya user join — history dekho

5. Comparison — ek table me

Redis Pub/SubKafkaWebSocket direct
DeliveryOnline ko hiPersistent, replayServer-specific
HistoryNahi (list alag se)Haan, built-inNahi
ScaleMediumVery highLow
Best forSimple chatLarge-scale chatDemo / 2 users

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

  • Pub/Sub ko history samajhna — offline ka message kho jaata hai.
  • Saari history Redis me rakhna — memory khatam, bill zyada.
  • Presence DB me rakhna — heartbeat se DB marega.
  • Ek server pe WebSocket, bina Redis ke — user doosre server pe ho to message nahi milega.
  • Message ordering ignore karna — list me order hai, Pub/Sub me guarantee kam.

7. Interview corner

Redis se chat app kaise banate ho?

Pub/Sub se live messages, List se recent history (trim ke saath), Set se online users, Sorted Set se typing/last-seen. Persistent history ke liye Postgres/Mongo, offline ke liye push notifications.

Pub/Sub ki sabse badi kami kya hai?

Fire-and-forget hai — offline subscriber ka message kho jaata hai. Isliye history alag se List/DB me save karni padti hai, aur offline users ko push bhejna padta hai.

10 servers hon to message sahi user tak kaise pahunchega?

Har server Redis Pub/Sub se subscribe karta hai — koi bhi server publish kare, saare servers ko milta hai, aur jis server pe user connected hai wo use deliver karta hai. Isi ko fan-out kehte hain.

Guide ke 2 stages — Redis chat

Stage 1: Connection Initialization

  1. Steps 1–2: Receiver chat application kholta hai. Client aur server ke beech WebSocket establish hota hai.
  2. Steps 3–4: pub-sub server Redis se kai connections banata hai — ek connection Redis data models update karne aur topic pe messages publish karne ke liye, baaki connections topics subscribe karke updates sunne ke liye.
  3. Steps 5–6: Receiver ke client ko chat member list aur historical message list chahiye — ye information Redis se lekar client ko bhej do.
  4. Steps 7–8: Receiver naya member hai, isliye member_add topic pe message publish hota hai — baaki participants Receiver ko dekh lete hain.

Stage 2: Message Handling

  1. Step 1: Receiver Sender ko chat me message bhejta hai.
  2. Step 2: naya message Redis SortedSet me zadd se add hota hai — messages arrival time ke hisaab se sorted hote hain. Phir pub-sub server message ko messages topic pe publish karta hai, taaki subscribers utha lein.
  3. Step 3: Sender ka client Receiver ka message receive karta hai.

8. Quick check

Q1. Live message sab online users ko turant bhejne ke liye Redis me kya use hota hai?

  • List
  • Pub/Sub — PUBLISH / SUBSCRIBE — sahi jawab
  • Hash

Q2. Offline user ka message na khoye, iske liye kya zaroori hai?

  • Kuch nahi, Pub/Sub sambhal lega
  • Message ko List/DB me save karna + push notification — sahi jawab
  • User ko online rehna padega
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: Pub/Sub live ke liye, List history ke liye, Set presence ke liye — teeno milke Redis se poori chat app ban jaati hai.

08How It Works · 8 / 18

Live Streaming Explained

Tum YouTube Live ya Instagram Live dekhte ho — video 2-3 second ke delay se tum tak pahunch raha hai, duniya bhar me lakhon logon ko ek saath. Peeche kaam karta hai live streaming pipeline: capture → encode → transcode → CDN → player. Ye page usi pipeline ko kholta hai.

1. Live Streaming Explained — pehle ek simple kahani

Socho ek cricket match hai. Camera wala match shoot karta hai (capture), ek banda use alag-alag size ke dabbon me pack karta hai — chhota dabba mobile ke liye, bada TV ke liye (transcode), phir dabbe sheher-sheher ke godown me pahunch jaate hain (CDN), aur tum apne ghar ke paas wale godown se lete ho (edge). Isliye video rukta nahi.

2. Gehrai me — tabs me samjho

1. Capture aur encode

Camera raw video banata hai — bahut bada (1080p raw ~ 1 Gbps!). Encoder use compress karta hai — H.264/H.265/AV1 codec se, bitrate ~5 Mbps. Phir video chunks me kata jaata hai — har chunk 2-10 second ka (HLS me .ts files, DASH me .m4s). Chunk hi streaming ki unit hai.

Example: 2-hour match — raw 900GB, H.264 encode ke baad ~4.5GB.

Sahi: chunk size chhota rakho (2 sec) to latency kam, bada rakho to efficiency zyada.
Galat: raw video seedha bhejna — bandwidth khatam, koi dekh nahi payega.

2. Transcode — har device ke liye

Ek hi stream sabko nahi chalegi — kisi ke paas 4G hai, kisi ke paas Wi-Fi, kisi ka phone purana hai. Transcoder ek stream se multiple renditions banata hai: 1080p, 720p, 480p, 360p — har ek alag bitrate pe. Ye hai adaptive bitrate (ABR) ki neev. Transcoding GPU farms pe hoti hai, real-time.

Example: tumhari network slow hui to player khud 1080p se 480p pe chala jaata hai — video rukta nahi, quality kam hoti hai.

Sahi: ladder banao — 1080p, 720p, 480p, 270p, 144p.
Galat: sirf 1080p — slow network wale dekh hi nahi payenge.

3. CDN — duniya bhar me delivery

Chunks origin server se CDN edge servers pe jaate hain — duniya bhar me 1000s of PoPs. Viewer ko sabse paas wale edge se video milta hai. Live me cache tricky hai — chunk aate hi edge pe push karna padta hai, nahi to har viewer origin pe aayega aur origin marega.

Example: 10 lakh viewers — origin se 10 lakh connections nahi, edge se 10 lakh, origin se sirf 100 edge connections.

Sahi: multi-CDN — ek CDN down ho to doosra.
Galat: origin se seedha serve karna — viral hote hi crash.

4. Player aur latency

Player manifest file (.m3u8 for HLS, .mpd for DASH) padhta hai — usme chunks ki list hoti hai. Player buffer karta hai 2-3 chunks, phir play karta hai. Latency: normal HLS ~10-30 sec, Low-Latency HLS ~2-5 sec, WebRTC < 1 sec (par scale mushkil). Latency vs scale ka trade-off hai.

Example: auction ya betting ho to WebRTC chahiye; cricket match ho to LL-HLS kaafi hai.

Sahi: use case se latency chunna — har live ko <1 sec nahi chahiye.
Galat: buffer 0 rakhna — ek hiccup aaya to video ruk jayega.

3. Aur gehrai me — details, numbers aur code

Streaming protocols — comparison

ProtocolLatencyScaleUse case
HLS10-30 secUnlimited (CDN)Normal live, VOD
Low-Latency HLS2-5 secUnlimitedSports, events
DASH10-30 secUnlimitedAndroid/Web standard
WebRTC< 1 secLimitedVideo call, auction
RTMP2-5 secIngest onlyStreamer → server

Pipeline — ek line me

Camera → RTMP ingest → Encoder (H.264)
  → Transcoder (1080p/720p/480p)
  → Origin → CDN edges
  → Player (manifest + chunks + ABR)

4. Try karo — live stream chalao, network kharab karo

Tum ek cricket match live dekh rahe ho. Network badlo, viewers badhao — dekho player aur CDN kya karte hain.

  1. Stream shuru karo
  2. Tumhara network slow hua (4G → 2G)
  3. Viewers 1,000 → 10 lakh!
  4. Latency check — kitna peeche ho?

5. Comparison — ek table me

Live streamingVideo on Demand (VOD)
ContentAbhi ban raha haiPehle se bana hua
LatencySeconds matterMatter nahi karta
TranscodeReal-time (mushkil)Offline (aaram se)
FailureStream ruk gaya = khatamRetry kar lo

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

  • Sirf ek rendition banana — slow network wale dekh nahi payenge.
  • CDN ke bina live karna — viral hote hi origin crash.
  • Chunk size bahut bada — latency 30+ sec ho jaayegi.
  • Buffer zero rakhna — network hiccup pe video rukega.
  • Har use case me WebRTC — 10 lakh viewers pe WebRTC ka cost aur complexity bahut zyada.

7. Interview corner

Live streaming pipeline ke main components kya hain?

Ingest (RTMP), encode (H.264), transcode (multiple renditions), origin, CDN (edge delivery), aur player (manifest + ABR). Har step ka kaam alag hai.

Adaptive bitrate (ABR) kya hai?

Ek hi video ki kai qualities (1080p/720p/480p) banake rakhna, aur player network dekh ke apne aap switch kare. Network slow ho to quality kam, video rukta nahi.

Latency vs scale ka trade-off?

WebRTC <1 sec latency deta hai par lakhon viewers scale karna mushkil hai. HLS unlimited scale karta hai par 10-30 sec latency. LL-HLS beech ka rasta hai — 2-5 sec, full scale.

Live Streaming Steps — guide ke 8 steps

YouTube, TikTok live ya Twitch pe live streaming kaise kaam karti hai? Regular streaming se farak ye hai ki video content real-time me internet se bheja jaata hai — usually sirf kuch seconds ki latency hoti hai.

  1. Step 1: microphone aur camera raw video data capture karte hain; data server side bheja jaata hai.
  2. Step 2: video data compress aur encode hota hai — compression algorithm background aur video elements ko alag karta hai; phir H.264 jaise standard me encode hota hai; is step ke baad video data ka size bahut chhota ho jaata hai.
  3. Step 3: encoded data chhote segments me baanta jaata hai (usually seconds long) — download ya stream karna bahut fast ho jaata hai.
  4. Step 4: segmented data streaming server ko bheja jaata hai. Server ko alag devices aur network conditions support karne hote hain — ise Adaptive Bitrate Streaming kehte hain: steps 2–3 me alag-alag bitrates pe multiple files banani padti hain.
  5. Step 5: live streaming data CDN (Content Delivery Network) ke edge servers pe push hota hai. Lakhon viewers paas ke edge server se video dekh sakte hain — CDN data transmission latency ko bahut kam kar deta hai.
  6. Step 6: viewers ke devices video data ko decode aur decompress karke video player me chalate hain.
  7. Steps 7 and 8: agar video replay ke liye store karni hai to encoded data storage server pe bheja jaata hai, aur viewers baad me wahan se replay maang sakte hain.

Standard protocols for live streaming

  • RTMP (Real-Time Messaging Protocol) — pehle Macromedia ne Flash player aur server ke beech data transmit karne ke liye banaya tha; ab internet pe video data stream karne ke liye use hota hai. Note karo: Skype jaise video conferencing apps RTC (Real-Time Communication) protocol use karte hain, lower latency ke liye.
  • HLS (HTTP Live Streaming) — isme H.264 ya H.265 encoding chahiye. Apple devices sirf HLS format accept karte hain.
  • DASH (Dynamic Adaptive Streaming over HTTP) — Apple devices ko support nahi karta.
  • HLS aur DASH dono adaptive bitrate streaming support karte hain.

8. Quick check

Q1. Slow network pe video rukne ke bajay quality kam kyun ho jaati hai?

  • Player kharab hai
  • Adaptive bitrate — player apne aap low quality rendition pe switch karta hai — sahi jawab
  • CDN slow hai

Q2. 10 lakh live viewers ko serve karne ke liye sabse zaroori cheez kya hai?

  • Bada origin server
  • CDN — viewers ko paas ke edge se serve karo — sahi jawab
  • Zyaada RAM
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: Capture → encode → transcode (har quality) → CDN edges → player (ABR) — latency aur scale ka balance hi live streaming hai.

09How It Works · 9 / 18

How to Design a System for Internationalization

Tumhari app sirf English me hai — par user Japan me hai, uska phone Arabic me hai, aur uski currency Yen hai. Internationalization (i18n) ka matlab hai app ko aise banana ki koi bhi bhasha, koi bhi desh, koi bhi culture bina code badle support ho jaaye. Ye page batata hai kaise.

1. How to Design a System for Internationalization — pehle ek simple kahani

Socho ek restaurant hai jiska menu sirf Hindi me hai. Japan se aaya customer bhooka hi wapas jaayega. i18n matlab menu ko aise banana ki har customer ko uski bhasha me menu mile — khana wahi, bas menu badla. Aur khana bhi uske hisaab se — kisi ko mirchi kam, kisi ko zyada.

2. Gehrai me — tabs me samjho

1. i18n vs l10n — farak samjho

Internationalization (i18n) = code ko aise banana ki koi bhi locale support ho sake (design). Localization (l10n) = ek specific locale ke liye translate karna (kaam). Pehle i18n karo (ek baar), phir har bhasha ke liye l10n karo (baar-baar). Bina i18n ke l10n matlab har bhasha ke liye code badalna.

Example: i18n = strings ko code se bahar nikaal ke files me rakhna. l10n = un files ko Japanese me translate karna.

Sahi: din 1 se i18n — baad me jodna 10x mehenga padta hai.
Galat: “Hello” code me hardcode, phir har bhasha ke liye if-else.

2. Text, dates, numbers, currency

Text: resource bundles — en.json, ja.json, ar.json; key se string nikalo. Dates: 12/31/2024 (US) vs 31/12/2024 (India) vs 2024/12/31 (Japan) — ICU/CLDR data use karo. Numbers: 1,000.5 vs 1.000,5 (Germany). Currency: $10 vs ₹10 vs ¥10 — symbol, position, decimals sab locale pe depend.

Example: price dikhana ho to Intl.NumberFormat('ja-JP', {currency:'JPY'}) — library khud format kar degi.

Sahi: Intl APIs / ICU libraries — khud format mat likho.
Galat: date ko string me jod ke dikhana — har locale me tootega.

3. RTL, plural, aur layout

RTL (right-to-left): Arabic/Hebrew me poora UI ulta hota hai — CSS logical properties (margin-inline-start) use karo, left/right nahi. Plurals: English me 1 item / 2 items, par Arabic me 6 forms hote hain! Text expansion: German text English se 30% lamba hota hai — button toot jaayega agar fixed width rakhi.

Example: “You have 1 message” — plural rules har bhasha me alag, ICU MessageFormat use karo.

Sahi: flexible layout, logical CSS, ICU plural rules.
Galat: fixed-width buttons aur left/right hardcoded.

4. Timezone, sorting, aur data

Timezone: DB me hamesha UTC me store karo, display karte waqt user ke timezone me convert karo. Sorting: har bhasha ki alphabet order alag hai — locale-aware collation use karo. Names/addresses: har desh ka format alag — “first name, last name” har jagah nahi hota. Phone numbers: libphonenumber jaisi library use karo.

Example: meeting 3pm IST hai to US wale ko uske timezone me dikhao — UTC store karo, display convert karo.

Sahi: store UTC, display local; names ke liye ek hi “full name” field behtar hai.
Galat: DB me local time store karna — daylight saving pe sab tootega.

3. Aur gehrai me — details, numbers aur code

i18n checklist — design karte waqt

AreaKya karna haiTool
StringsCode se bahar, key-based bundlesi18next, FormatJS
Dates/numbersLocale-aware formatIntl API, ICU/CLDR
PluralsICU MessageFormatICU
RTLLogical CSS propertiesCSS logical props
TimezoneStore UTC, display localmoment/dayjs + tz
Images/iconsCulture-neutral, text-free—

Galat vs sahi — code me

// GALAT: hardcoded + string jodna
return 'You have ' + n + ' messages';  // Arabic me tootega
// SAHI: ICU MessageFormat
'{n, plural, =0 {No messages} =1 {1 message} other {# messages}}'
// Har locale ke plural rules khud handle honge

4. Try karo — ek hi app, 3 desh

Ek hi screen hai — price, date aur message. Locale badlo aur dekho UI kaise badalta hai. Yehi i18n ka magic hai: code wahi, display alag.

  1. Locale: English (US)
  2. Locale: Hindi (India)
  3. Locale: Japanese (Japan)
  4. Locale: Arabic (UAE)

5. Comparison — ek table me

CheezUSIndiaGermanyJapan
Date12/31/202431/12/202431.12.20242024/12/31
Number1,000.51,000.51.000,51,000.5
Currency$10₹1010 €¥10
DirectionLTRLTRLTRLTR

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

  • Strings hardcode karna — har bhasha ke liye code badalna padega.
  • DB me local time store karna — DST aur timezone pe sab tootega.
  • Plural ke liye sirf 's' jodna — Arabic me 6 forms, Russian me 3.
  • Fixed-width UI — German text 30% lamba, button se bahar niklega.
  • left/right CSS hardcode — RTL me UI ulta nahi hoga, toota hua lagega.

7. Interview corner

i18n aur l10n me farak kya hai?

i18n design hai — code ko locale-ready banana (ek baar). l10n kaam hai — ek locale ke liye translate karna (har bhasha ke liye). Bina i18n ke l10n har baar code badlega.

Timezone kaise handle karte ho?

DB me hamesha UTC me store karo, display karte waqt user ke timezone me convert karo. Local time store karoge to daylight saving aur user ke travel pe sab toot jaayega.

RTL languages ke liye UI me kya badalta hai?

Poora layout ulta — CSS logical properties (margin-inline-start) use karo, left/right hardcoded mat karo. Icons bhi mirror hote hain (back arrow ulta).

Guide ke 5 areas — exact rules

  • Language: saare texts alag system me extract aur maintain karo — prompts source code me mat daalo; code me string concatenation avoid karo; graphics se text hatao; complete sentences use karo, dynamic text elements avoid karo; currencies jaise business data alag languages me display karo.
  • Layout: text length describe karo aur alag languages ke liye text ke aas-paas kaafi space reserve karo; line wrap aur truncation plan karo; button labels chhote rakho; numerals, dates, timestamps aur addresses ka display adjust karo.
  • Time zone: time display ko timestamp storage se alag rakho. Common practice: database aur backend services ke liye UTC (Coordinated Universal Time) timestamp use karo, aur frontend display ke liye local time zone use karo.
  • Currency: displayed currencies aur settlement currency define karo; prices quote karne ke liye foreign exchange service design karo.
  • Company entity and accounting: har desh ke liye alag entity set up karni hoti hai, aur ye entities alag regulations aur accounting standards follow karti hain — isliye system ko multiple bookkeeping methods support karne chahiye. Company-level treasury management aksar chahiye hoti hai. Har desh ya region ki usage habits ke hisaab se business logic ko extract karna bhi zaroori hai.

8. Quick check

Q1. Database me time kaise store karna chahiye?

  • User ke local time me
  • Hamesha UTC me, display pe convert karo — sahi jawab
  • String me, jaise 'kal 3 baje'

Q2. i18n ka pehla step kya hai?

  • Google Translate se sab translate karna
  • Strings ko code se bahar nikaal ke key-based bundles me rakhna — sahi jawab
  • Har bhasha ke liye alag app banana
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: Code locale-ready banao (i18n), phir har bhasha ke liye translate karo (l10n) — strings bahar, time UTC me, aur UI flexible rakho.

10How It Works · 10 / 18

How to Design Google Docs

Google Docs me 10 log ek saath ek hi document edit karte hain — aur kisi ka text kabhi overwrite nahi hota, cursor dikhte hain, aur har change turant sabko dikhta hai. Ye magic hai real-time collaboration ka: Operational Transformation (OT) ya CRDT — do algorithms jo concurrent edits ko bina ladai ke merge karte hain.

1. How to Design Google Docs — pehle ek simple kahani

Socho 10 log ek hi kagaz pe ek saath likh rahe hain — koi upar se, koi neeche se. Kagaz phat jaayega! Google Docs me har likhne wala ek alag rang ka pen use karta hai, aur ek smart manager (server) har line ko sahi jagah chipkata hai — kisi ki line kisi ki line ke upar nahi aati, sab apni jagah pe rehte hain.

2. Gehrai me — tabs me samjho

1. Problem — do log ek saath edit karein to?

Tum “Hello” likhte ho, Seema usi jagah “Hi” likhti hai — dono ke edits ek saath server pe pahunche. Bina kuch kiye to ek ka text doosre ko overwrite kar dega ya galat jagah chipak jayega. Is problem ko concurrency control kehte hain. Solutions: OT (Operational Transformation) — Google Docs ka tareeka; CRDT — Figma/Apple Notes ka tareeka.

Example: tum position 5 pe “X” daalo, Seema position 3 pe “Y” daale — dono ko final doc ek jaisa dikhna chahiye.

Sahi: har edit ko operation banao (insert/delete + position), phir transform karo.
Galat: “last write wins” — ek ka kaam hamesha kho jaayega.

2. Operational Transformation (OT)

OT me server central authority hai. Har operation server pe aata hai, server use transform karta hai pehle wale operations ke hisaab se (position shift karo), phir sabko broadcast karta hai. Sab clients same order me operations apply karte hain — isliye sabka document eventually consistent hota hai.

Example: tumne pos 5 pe X daala, Seema ne pos 3 pe Y daala — server Seema ka Y pehle apply karta hai, tumhara X pos 6 ho jaata hai (shift). Dono ko same result.

Sahi: OT simple hai jab server central ho — Google Docs isliye OT use karta hai.
Galat: OT ko peer-to-peer me use karna — transform logic bahut complex ho jaata hai.

3. CRDT — bina server ke bhi

CRDT me har operation mathematically mergeable hota hai — order se farak nahi padta, koi bhi order me apply karo, result same. Har character ki unique ID hoti hai (clientID + counter), aur delete matlab tombstone (character hataya nahi, “deleted” mark kiya). Isliye offline editing bhi kaam karti hai — wapas aate hi merge ho jaata hai.

Example: flight me offline edit karo, landing pe sync — koi conflict nahi, sab merge.

Sahi: CRDT offline-first aur peer-to-peer ke liye best hai.
Galat: CRDT me memory — tombstones badhte rehte hain, cleanup chahiye.

4. Baaki pieces — presence, history, scale

Presence: cursor aur selection WebSocket se broadcast hote hain (har client ka rang alag). History: har operation log hota hai — version history aur undo isi se banta hai. Scale: document sharded hota hai (ek doc = ek collaboration session), WebSocket servers ke peeche Redis Pub/Sub se broadcast. Persistence: operations ko periodically snapshot + log me save karo.

Example: 100 log ek doc me — har keystroke ek operation, server 1000 ops/sec broadcast karta hai.

Sahi: snapshot har N operations pe — load karte waqt poora log replay na karna pade.
Galat: har keystroke pe poora document save karna — DB marega.

3. Aur gehrai me — details, numbers aur code

OT vs CRDT — comparison

OTCRDT
Server chahiye?Haan, centralNahi, peer-to-peer bhi
Offline editMushkilNatural
ComplexityTransform logicData structure
Use karta haiGoogle DocsFigma, Apple Notes
MemoryLowTombstones badhte hain

Operation kaisa dikhta hai?

// Tum type karte ho 'X' position 5 pe
op = { type: 'insert', pos: 5, char: 'X', client: 'rahul', seq: 42 }
// Server transform karta hai (Seema ne pos 3 pe 'Y' daala tha)
op.pos = 6   // shift! kyunki 'Y' pehle aa gaya
// Sab clients ko broadcast — sabka doc same

4. Try karo — do log ek saath type karein

Tum aur Seema ek hi document edit kar rahe ho — ek hi jagah! Buttons dabao aur dekho OT kaise dono ke edits ko bina khoye merge karta hai.

  1. Dono ek saath type karte hain
  2. OT transform karo
  3. CRDT: offline edit + sync
  4. Presence — cursor dikhao

5. Comparison — ek table me

FeatureGoogle Docs (OT)Simple shared doc (lock)
Ek saath editHaan, sabEk time pe ek hi
OfflineLimitedNahi
UndoPer-user historyGlobal, confusing
ComplexityHighLow

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

  • Last-write-wins use karna — ek user ka kaam hamesha khoyega.
  • Har keystroke pe poora doc save karna — DB aur network dono maregi.
  • Presence ko har keystroke pe broadcast karna — throttle karo, nahi to flood hoga.
  • Snapshot na lena — doc kholte waqt hazaaron operations replay karne padenge.
  • Undo ko global rakhna — tumhara undo Seema ka kaam na mitaye.

7. Interview corner

Do log ek saath edit karein to conflict kaise solve hota hai?

OT ya CRDT se. OT me server operations ko transform karke same order me apply karwata hai. CRDT me operations mathematically mergeable hote hain — koi bhi order me same result. Last-write-wins galat hai — data kho jaata hai.

CRDT OT se behtar kab hai?

Jab offline editing ya peer-to-peer chahiye — CRDT me order matter nahi karta, isliye offline edits aaram se merge ho jaati hain. OT ko central server chahiye.

Google Docs me cursor kaise dikhte hain?

Presence WebSocket se broadcast hoti hai — har client apna cursor position aur selection bhejta hai (throttled), server dusron ko bhej deta hai. Ye document data se alag channel hai.

8. Quick check

Q1. Do users ek hi position pe type karein — sahi solution kya hai?

  • Last write wins — ek ka text kho jaayega
  • OT/CRDT se operations transform/merge karke dono ko bachana — sahi jawab
  • Ek user ko block kar dena

Q2. CRDT ki sabse badi taakat kya hai?

  • Server fast hota hai
  • Offline edits bhi bina conflict ke merge ho jaati hain — sahi jawab
  • Kam memory use hoti hai
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: Har keystroke ek operation hai — OT use transform karke, CRDT use merge karke, dono ka kaam bachata hai. Isi liye Google Docs me kabhi ladai nahi hoti.

11How It Works · 11 / 18

Experiment Platform Architecture

Netflix ne ek naya button lagaya — kya users use zyada dekhenge? Ye jaanne ke liye Experiment Platform (A/B testing) chahiye: aadhe users ko naya design, aadhe ko purana, phir dekho kaun zyada click karta hai. Ye page batata hai experiment platform ki architecture — assignment, metrics, aur analysis.

1. Experiment Platform Architecture — pehle ek simple kahani

Socho ek dukaan me do tarah ki packaging rakhi hai — aadhe customers ko laal dabba, aadhe ko neela. Hafte bhar dekho kaunsa dabba zyada bikta hai. Experiment platform wahi dukaan hai — bas customers lakhon hain, aur faisla data se hota hai, guess se nahi.

2. Gehrai me — tabs me samjho

1. Assignment — kaun kya dekhega?

Har user ko deterministically ek variant me daalo — hash(user_id + experiment_id) % 100 — 0-49 control (purana), 50-99 treatment (naya). Hash se sticky assignment milti hai — user har baar wahi variant dekhta hai. Layering se ek user ek saath kai experiments me ho sakta hai (alag features pe).

Example: user_id 12345 ka hash 72 aaya → treatment — use naya button dikhega, hamesha.

Sahi: hash-based assignment — consistent, bina DB ke, koi bhi server same faisla karega.
Galat: random har request pe — user ko kabhi naya, kabhi purana dikhega, data kachra.

2. Metrics — kya measure karoge?

Pehle guardrail metrics (kuch toota to nahi — error rate, latency), phir primary metric (jo badhana hai — click rate, conversion), aur secondary metrics (side effects). Metrics events se bante hain — har click, view, purchase ek event hai jo pipeline me jaata hai. Sample size pehle se nikalo — chhota sample galat faisla dega.

Example: button ka rang badla — primary metric: click-through rate; guardrail: page load time na badhe.

Sahi: metrics experiment se pehle likh lo — baad me dhoondhoge to cherry-picking hogi.
Galat: 100 metrics me se jo achha laga use report karna.

3. Analysis — jeeta kaun?

Data aane ke baad statistical test — treatment vs control ka difference significant hai ya random? p-value < 0.05 aur confidence interval dekho. Peeking mat karo — roz result dekh ke jaldi faisla loge to false positive milega. SRM (sample ratio mismatch) check karo — 50/50 bola tha, 60/40 aaya to assignment me bug hai.

Example: treatment +2% conversion, p=0.03 — significant, launch karo. p=0.4 — random hai, launch mat karo.

Sahi: pre-registered metrics + fixed duration — faisla pehle se tay.
Galat: roz dashboard dekh ke “ab to jeet raha hai” bol ke launch karna.

4. Platform pieces — config, SDK, pipeline

Config service: kaunsa experiment live hai, kitne % users pe. SDK: app me getVariant('exp1') call karo — flag mil gaya. Event pipeline: exposure + metrics events warehouse me. Analysis service: roz ke aggregates + stats. Kill switch: kuch gadbad ho to ek click me experiment band.

Example: naya checkout crash kar raha hai — kill switch se 10 sec me sabko purana checkout wapas.

Sahi: kill switch har experiment pe — safety pehle.
Galat: experiment code me hardcode — band karne ke liye deploy karna pade.

3. Aur gehrai me — details, numbers aur code

Experiment lifecycle

StageKya hota hai
1. DesignHypothesis + metrics + sample size likho
2. Ramp1% → 5% → 25% → 50% — dheere-dheere badhao
3. RunFixed duration chalao, peeking mat karo
4. AnalyseStats test, SRM check, guardrails dekho
5. DecideLaunch / iterate / kill

Assignment — code jaisa

def get_variant(user_id, exp_id):
    h = hash(user_id + exp_id) % 100
    if h < 50: return 'control'    # purana design
    return 'treatment'                 # naya design
# Same user, same experiment = same variant, hamesha

4. Try karo — A/B test chalao, faisla karo

Naya button design test karna hai. Pehle users assign karo, phir results dekho — aur sahi statistical faisla karo.

  1. 1. Users assign karo
  2. 2. Test chalao — 7 din
  3. 3. Stats test — jeeta kaun?
  4. 4. Galat faisla — peeking ka nuksaan

5. Comparison — ek table me

A/B testFeature flag (bina test)
GoalKaunsa behtar hai, measure karoBas on/off karo
UsersSplit, stickySab ya koi
FaislaStats seGuess se
RiskLow (ramp)Medium

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

  • Non-sticky assignment — user ko kabhi naya, kabhi purana — data kachra.
  • Peeking — roz result dekh ke jaldi launch — false positive.
  • Metrics baad me chunna — cherry-picking, galat faisla.
  • SRM ignore karna — 50/50 ke bajay 60/40 aaya to assignment me bug hai.
  • Kill switch na rakhna — kharab experiment ko band karne ke liye deploy karna pade.

7. Interview corner

A/B test me user ko variant kaise assign karte ho?

Hash-based: hash(user_id + experiment_id) % 100 — deterministic aur sticky. Har server bina DB ke same faisla karta hai, aur user hamesha wahi variant dekhta hai.

p-value kya hota hai?

Ye probability hai ki jo difference dikh raha hai wo sirf random hai. p < 0.05 matlab difference significant hai — 95% confidence ke saath keh sakte ho treatment behtar hai.

SRM kya hai aur kyun check karte ho?

Sample Ratio Mismatch — agar 50/50 bola tha aur 60/40 aaya, to assignment me bug hai (jaise koi variant crash kar raha hai). SRM milte hi experiment roko aur bug dhoondho.

Guide ke 4 high-level components

Ye content Trustworthy Online Controlled Experiments book se hai (redrawn). Platform me 4 high-level components hain:

Key Components

  1. Experiment definition, setup, and management via a UI. Ye experiment system configuration me store hote hain.
  2. Experiment deployment — server aur client-side dono pe (variant assignment aur parameterization samet).
  3. Experiment instrumentation.
  4. Experiment analysis.

8. Quick check

Q1. User ko har baar wahi variant dikhe — iske liye assignment kaisi honi chahiye?

  • Har request pe random
  • Hash-based deterministic aur sticky — sahi jawab
  • Pehle aao pehle pao

Q2. A/B test ka result kab dekhna chahiye?

  • Roz, jab mann kare
  • Fixed duration ke baad — peeking se false positive milta hai — sahi jawab
  • Pehle din hi
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: Hash se sticky assign karo, metrics pehle likho, fixed duration chalao, phir stats se faisla karo — guess se nahi, data se.

12How It Works · 12 / 18

Design Google Maps

Google Maps pe tum “paas ka petrol pump” dhoondhte ho, route nikaalte ho, traffic dekhte ho — peeche arabon locations, real-time traffic, aur routing algorithms kaam karte hain. Ye page Google Maps ko system design ki nazar se kholta hai: tiles, geohash, routing, aur live traffic.

1. Design Google Maps — pehle ek simple kahani

Socho ek sheher ka bada atlas hai — use chhote-chhote panno (tiles) me kaata gaya hai. Tum jo hissa dekhte ho, wahi panna nikal ke dikhaya jaata hai. Rasta dhoondhna matlab panno pe bani sadkon pe sabse chhota rasta nikaalna — aur traffic matlab har sadak pe kitni gaadiyan hain, ye live dekhna.

2. Gehrai me — tabs me samjho

1. Maps ka data — tiles aur places

Duniya ka map tiles me bata hai — har zoom level pe chhote square images (256x256). Tum jo area dekhte ho, sirf wahi tiles load hoti hain (CDN se). Places (restaurants, pumps) spatial index me hain — quadtree / geohash / S2 cells (Google ka system: duniya ko cells me baantna). Har place ka lat/long + geohash hota hai.

Example: zoom 15 pe Delhi ke ~100 tiles, zoom 10 pe poora India ~50 tiles — jitna zoom out, utne kam tiles.

Sahi: S2 cells — Google ka spherical geometry system, lat/long se behtar.
Galat: poora map ek image — load hi nahi hoga.

2. Nearby search — paas kya hai?

“Paas ka petrol pump” = spatial query: tumhari location ka geohash/S2 cell nikalo, aas-paas ke cells me places dhoondho, distance se sort karo. Quadtree ya geohash prefix se fast search hoti hai. Results rank hote hain — distance + rating + popularity.

Example: 10 lakh places me se 2km wale 20 — quadtree se sirf aas-paas wale cells check hue.

Sahi: geohash se coarse filter, phir exact distance se sort.
Galat: saare places ki distance nikaal ke sort karna.

3. Routing — sabse accha rasta

Roads ek graph hain — nodes = chauraha, edges = sadak, weight = time/distance. Dijkstra / A* se shortest path, par poori duniya ka graph bahut bada hai — isliye Contraction Hierarchies ya precomputed routes use hote hain. Traffic weight ko live badalta hai — jam wali sadak ka weight badh gaya to route badal jaata hai.

Example: Delhi se Gurgaon — 3 routes, traffic dekh ke jo sabse fast hai wo dikhaya.

Sahi: A* + live traffic weights — fast aur accurate.
Galat: har request pe poora graph Dijkstra se — seconds lag jaayenge.

4. Live traffic aur ETA

Traffic data aata hai users ke phones se (anonymous location + speed) aur road sensors se. Har road segment ki current speed nikaal ke ETA calculate hoti hai. Historical data bhi use hota hai — “Shukravar shaam 6 baje yahan jam hota hai.” Machine learning dono ko mila ke ETA deta hai.

Example: tumhare phone ki speed 5 km/h hai to system samajhta hai tum jam me ho — aur dusron ko batata hai.

Sahi: real-time + historical dono — sirf ek se ETA galat hogi.
Galat: users ka exact location store karna — privacy ka dhyaan rakho, aggregate karo.

3. Aur gehrai me — details, numbers aur code

Google Maps — blocks

BlockKaamTech
Tile serviceMap dikhanaPre-rendered tiles + CDN
Places indexNearby searchS2 cells / geohash
RoutingShortest pathA*, Contraction Hierarchies
TrafficLive jam + ETAPhone probes + ML
Search'Pizza near me'Inverted index + spatial

Scale estimate

1B+ users, 100M+ places
Tiles: zoom levels 0-20, har level pe 4x tiles
Routing: har din arabon queries
ETA: har road segment pe speed, har minute update

4. Try karo — route nikalo, traffic badlo

Tumhe Connaught Place se Gurgaon jaana hai. Route nikalo, phir traffic badhao — dekho Maps kaise dobara route banata hai.

  1. Route nikalo — CP se Gurgaon
  2. NH-48 pe jam lag gaya!
  3. Paas ka petrol pump dhoondho
  4. ETA kaise banti hai?

5. Comparison — ek table me

FeatureKaiseChallenge
Map displayTiles + CDNStorage (zoom levels)
Nearby searchS2 / geohashBoundary cases
RoutingA* + hierarchiesGraph bahut bada
TrafficPhone probesPrivacy + sparsity

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

  • Poora graph har request pe search karna — precomputation zaroori hai.
  • Traffic ke bina routing — sabse chhota rasta jam me phas sakta hai.
  • Geohash boundary ignore karna — paas ki jagah miss ho jaayegi.
  • Exact user location store karna — aggregate karo, privacy bachao.
  • Tiles ko har baar render karna — pre-render + cache karo.

7. Interview corner

Nearby places kaise dhoondhte ho — 'paas ka ATM'?

Location ko S2 cell ya geohash me convert karo, aas-paas ke cells me places search karo, phir exact distance se sort karo. Quadtree/S2 se poora data scan nahi karna padta.

Routing ke liye kaunsa algorithm?

A* — Dijkstra + heuristic (seedhi distance). Poori duniya ke graph pe Contraction Hierarchies use hoti hain taaki query milliseconds me aaye. Live traffic edge weights ko update karta hai.

Live traffic ka data kahan se aata hai?

Users ke phones se — anonymous speed + location (probe data), plus road sensors aur historical patterns. ML live + history mila ke ETA banata hai.

Guide ke 3 components + numbers

Google ne Google Maps project 2005 me shuru kiya. March 2021 tak Google Maps ke one billion (1 arab) daily active users the, aur duniya ki 99% coverage thi. System bahut complex hai, par 3 high-level components me baanta ja sakta hai:

Location Service

User ke location updates record karna iska kaam hai. Google Map clients har kuch seconds me location update bhejte hain. Ye location data 3 kaam aata hai: naye aur recently band roads detect karna; time ke saath map ki accuracy improve karna; live traffic data ka input.

Map Rendering

Duniya ka map ek badi 2D map image me project hota hai. Ye chhote image blocks me tootta hai, jinhe tiles kehte hain. Tiles static hote hain — bahut rarely change hote hain. Static tile files serve karne ka efficient tareeka hai CDN, jiske peeche S3 jaise cloud storage ho. Users paas ke CDN se zaroori tiles load karke map bana lete hain. Zoom aur pan karte waqt alag zoom levels ke map blocks pre-calculate karke rakho, zaroorat padne pe images load karo.

Navigation Service

Point A se point B tak reasonably fast route dhoondhna iska kaam hai. Ye 2 services ko call karta hai:

  1. Geocoding Service: diye gaye address ko latitude/longitude pair me badalta hai.
  2. Route Planner Service: sequence me 3 kaam karta hai — A aur B ke beech top-K shortest paths calculate karo; current traffic aur historical data se har path ka time estimate karo; time predictions aur user filtering se paths rank karo (jaise user toll avoid karna chahta hai).

8. Quick check

Q1. Map ko chhote hisso me baant ke dikhane ko kya kehte hain?

  • Tiles — har zoom level pe chhote square images — sahi jawab
  • Pixels
  • Layers

Q2. Jam lagte hi Maps route kyun badal deta hai?

  • Random hai
  • Traffic se road ka weight badhta hai, to algorithm dusra route chun leta hai — sahi jawab
  • Map purana ho gaya
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: Tiles se map, S2 cells se nearby, A* + live traffic se route, aur phones se traffic — yehi Google Maps hai.
