13How It Works · 13 / 18

Designing a Chat Application

WhatsApp pe tum message bhejte ho — tick, double tick, blue tick — aur 2 billion log ek saath chat karte hain. Peeche hai WebSocket connections, message queues, aur presence ka system. Ye page WhatsApp/Messenger/Discord jaisi chat app ko design ki nazar se kholta hai.

1. Designing a Chat Application — pehle ek simple kahani

Socho ek bahut bada dak-khana hai jisme har insaan ke liye ek khidki hai (WebSocket connection). Tum khat dete ho, dak-khana use sahi khidki tak pahuncha deta hai. Agar saamne wala ghar pe nahi hai to khat uske dabbe me rakh diya jaata hai (offline queue), aur wapas aate hi use de diya jaata hai.

2. Gehrai me — tabs me samjho

1. Requirements aur scale

Scale: 2B users, 100B+ messages/day, real-time delivery (< 1 sec), group chats (256 members), media, voice/video calls. Functional: 1:1 + group chat, ticks (sent/delivered/read), online status, typing indicator. Non-functional: message kabhi lose nahi hona chahiye, order bana rehna chahiye.

Estimate: 100B/day ≈ 1.2M msgs/sec average, peak 3-4x.

Sahi: pehle 1:1 chat, phir group — group fan-out alag challenge hai.
Galat: group ko 1:1 jaisa samajhna — 256 members = 256 deliveries.

2. Connection — WebSocket gateway

Har user ka phone WebSocket se ek gateway server se juda rehta hai (long-lived connection). Gateway stateless nahi hota — use pata hota hai kaunsa user kis server pe hai (connection registry — Redis me: user → server). Message aaye to gateway use route karta hai sahi server pe, ya queue me daalta hai agar user offline hai.

Example: tum server #5 pe connected ho — Seema ka message pehle router pe aata hai, phir server #5 pe, phir tum tak.

Sahi: connection mapping Redis me — koi bhi server kisi bhi user ko dhoondh sake.
Galat: user-to-server mapping ek server ki memory me — wo mare to sab lost.

3. Message flow aur storage

Message: client → gateway → message service → DB me store (sharded by chat/user) → queue se recipient ke gateway pe → recipient. Order: har chat me sequence number — client sequence dekh ke order karta hai. Group: ek message 256 copies nahi — fan-out queue se, har member ko alag delivery.

Example: group me ek message — 256 members, 256 deliveries, par storage me ek hi copy + per-user inbox pointer.

Sahi: message ek baar store, fan-out delivery alag — storage bachta hai.
Galat: har member ke liye poora message copy karna — storage phat jaayega.

4. Presence, ticks, aur media

Presence: online/last-seen Redis me (heartbeat + TTL). Ticks: sent = server pe pahuncha, delivered = recipient ke phone pe pahuncha, read = app ne padh liya — har stage pe ack wapas jaata hai. Media: photo/video object storage (S3) me, message me sirf URL + thumbnail. E2E encryption: Signal protocol — server message padh nahi sakta.

Example: blue tick matlab recipient ne app khol ke padha — ack chain: phone → server → sender.

Sahi: ack har stage pe — bina ack ke sender ko pata nahi chalega.
Galat: media ko DB me blob — object storage ka kaam hai.

3. Aur gehrai me — details, numbers aur code

Chat architecture — blocks

BlockKaamTech
WS GatewayLong-lived connectionsWebSocket, sticky
Connection registryUser → server mappingRedis
Message serviceStore + routeStateless service
Message storeHistoryCassandra/Scylla, chat shard
QueueOffline deliveryKafka
PushOffline users ko jagaoFCM / APNs
Media storePhotos/videosS3 + CDN

Group fan-out ka hisaab

1:1 message: 1 delivery
Group (256 members): 256 deliveries
1M groups active ho to: fan-out hi bottleneck hai
Solution: message ek baar store + per-user inbox
  (pointer) — delivery queue se dheere-dheere

4. Try karo — message bhejo, ticks dekho

Tum Seema ko message bhej rahe ho. Steps dabao — dekho message kahan se kahan jaata hai, aur ticks kaise bante hain.

  1. 1. Tum message bhejte ho
  2. 2. Seema tak pahuncha
  3. 3. Seema ne padha — blue tick!
  4. 4. Group me message — 256 log!

5. Comparison — ek table me

WhatsApp styleSimple Redis chat (p.318)
ScaleBillionsThousands
DeliveryKafka + acksPub/Sub
StorageCassandra, shardedRedis list
EncryptionE2E (Signal)Nahi

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

  • Message bina store kiye forward karna — server restart = message lost.
  • Group me har member ko full copy — storage aur fan-out dono phatenge.
  • Connection mapping memory me — server mare to users lost.
  • Bina sequence number ke — messages galat order me dikhenge.
  • Media DB me — object storage use karo.

7. Interview corner

WhatsApp me message ka flow kya hai?

Client WebSocket se gateway pe, message service DB me store karti hai, router recipient ke gateway ko dhoondhta hai (Redis mapping), phir recipient tak. Offline ho to queue + push notification.

Ticks (sent/delivered/read) kaise kaam karte hain?

Har stage pe ack: server pe pahuncha = 1 tick, recipient ke phone pe = 2 ticks, app ne padha = blue ticks. Ack chain wapas sender tak jaati hai.

Group chat me fan-out kaise handle karte ho?

Message ek baar store karo, phir queue se har member ko alag delivery karo. Online ko WebSocket se, offline ko push se. 256 members = 256 deliveries, par storage ek hi copy.

Guide ke 2 flows — exact steps

User Login Flow

  1. Step 1: Sender chat application me login karti hai aur server side se WebSocket connection establish karti hai.
  2. Steps 2–4: presence service Sender ki notification receive karta hai, uski presence update karta hai, aur Sender ke friends ko uski presence ke baare me notify karta hai.

Messaging Flow

  1. Steps 1–2: Sender Receiver ko chat message bhejti hai. Chat message Chat Service A ko route hota hai.
  2. Steps 3–4: chat message sequencing service ko bheja jaata hai, jo unique ID generate karta hai, aur message store me persist hota hai.
  3. Step 5: chat message message sync queue me bheja jaata hai, Receiver ki chat service se sync hone ke liye.
  4. Step 6: forward karne se pehle message sync service Receiver ki presence check karta hai — Receiver online hai to message Chat Service B ko jaata hai; offline hai to message push server ko jaata hai aur Receiver ke device pe push hota hai.
  5. Steps 7–8: Receiver online hai to chat message WebSocket se Receiver tak push hota hai.

8. Quick check

Q1. User kis server pe connected hai — ye mapping kahan rakhi jaati hai?

  • Us server ki memory me
  • Redis me — user → server mapping, taaki koi bhi server dhoondh sake — sahi jawab
  • User ke phone me

Q2. Group (256 members) me ek message bheja — storage me kitni copies?

  • 256 copies
  • Ek hi copy + har member ke liye pointer/delivery — sahi jawab
  • Zero — store hi nahi hota
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: WebSocket se connection, Redis se mapping, DB me store, queue se fan-out, aur har stage pe ack — yehi WhatsApp ka engine hai.

14How It Works · 14 / 18

Design Stock Exchange

Stock exchange pe har second lakhon orders aate hain — buy, sell, cancel — aur har order ka match millisecond me hona chahiye. Ek galat match matlab karodon ka nuksaan. Matching engine hi stock exchange ka dil hai: order book, price-time priority, aur atomic trades.

1. Design Stock Exchange — pehle ek simple kahani

Socho ek sabzi mandi hai — ek taraf khareedne wale bol rahe hain “₹100 me 10 kilo”, doosri taraf bechne wale “₹100 me 10 kilo”. Jaise hi dono ke daam mil jaayein, sauda ho jaata hai. Matching engine wahi mandi ka munshi hai — bas wo second me lakhon saude milata hai, aur kabhi galti nahi karta.

2. Gehrai me — tabs me samjho

1. Order book — khareed-bikri ki list

Order book do lists hai: bids (kharidne wale — price high to low) aur asks (bechne wale — price low to high). Beech ka gap spread hai. Naya order aate hi engine check karta hai — kya opposite side pe matching price hai? Hai to trade, nahi to order book me add.

Example: best bid ₹100 (100 shares), best ask ₹101 — spread ₹1. Koi ₹101 pe khareedne aaya to trade ho gaya.

Sahi: order book in-memory sorted structure (price levels) — disk se nahi, microsecond chahiye.
Galat: har order pe DB query — millisecond bhi slow hai yahan.

2. Matching rules — price-time priority

Match ka rule: pehle best price, phir pehle aaya order (price-time priority). ₹102 wala bid ₹100 wale se pehle match hoga; same price pe jo pehle aaya wo pehle. Market order = kisi bhi price pe turant lo; limit order = is price ya behtar pe hi lo. Partial fill bhi hota hai — 100 chahiye, 60 hi mile.

Example: tum ₹105 pe 100 shares khareedna chahte ho, asks hain ₹102 (50) aur ₹103 (50) — dono se trade, average ₹102.5.

Sahi: price-time priority — fair aur predictable.
Galat: random matching — traders bharosa kho denge.

3. Speed — microseconds matter

Exchange me latency microsecond me maapi jaati hai. Isliye matching engine single-threaded, in-memory hota hai — ek hi thread orders ko sequence me process karta hai (koi lock, koi race nahi). Colocation — traders ke servers exchange ke paas hi hote hain. Deterministic — har order ka sequence number, replay se wahi result.

Example: ek microsecond ki badhat ke liye firms karodon kharch karti hain (HFT).

Sahi: single-threaded + in-memory = deterministic aur fast.
Galat: multi-threaded matching — race condition = galat trades.

4. Risk, settlement, aur scale

Trade ke baad: clearing (kaun kisko kitna dega), settlement (T+1 din me paise/shares transfer). Risk checks order se pehle — balance hai? Limit cross to nahi? Circuit breaker — market 10% gira to trading roko. Scale: har stock ka alag matching engine (shard by symbol) — Reliance ka engine TCS se alag.

Example: tumhare paas ₹10,000 hain, ₹1 lakh ka order — risk check pehle hi reject kar dega.

Sahi: pre-trade risk check — galat order engine tak pahunche hi nahi.
Galat: trade ke baad risk check — tab tak nuksaan ho chuka.

3. Aur gehrai me — details, numbers aur code

Order book — example

Bids (kharidna)QtyAsks (bechna)Qty
₹100500₹101300
₹99800₹102700
₹981200₹103900

Best bid ₹100, best ask ₹101, spread ₹1. Tum ₹101 pe 200 khareedo → 200 shares ₹101 pe trade, ask 300 → 100 bacha.

Order types

Market order: turant, kisi bhi price pe — fast, price risk
Limit order:  is price ya behtar pe hi — control, fill na bhi ho
Stop-loss:    price gira to auto-sell — nuksaan rokna
IOC:          Immediate or Cancel — bacha hua cancel
GTC:          Good Till Cancelled — bhar ke rakho

4. Try karo — stock exchange chalao

Tum trader ho. Order book dekho, orders daalo — dekho matching engine kaise trade banata hai.

  1. Order book dekho
  2. Tum: 200 shares @ ₹101 (limit buy)
  3. Tum: 500 shares MARKET buy
  4. Circuit breaker — market 10% gira!

5. Comparison — ek table me

Stock exchangeNormal e-commerce
LatencyMicrosecondsMilliseconds ok
ConsistencyStrict, deterministicEventual ok
OrderPrice-time priorityFirst come
Failure costKarodonEk order

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

  • Matching ko multi-threaded banana — race = galat trades.
  • Order book DB me rakhna — microsecond chahiye, disk nahi.
  • Pre-trade risk check bhoolna — bina balance ke order match ho gaya to settlement fail.
  • Sequence number na rakhna — replay/audit impossible.
  • Circuit breaker na rakhna — panic me market khatam.

7. Interview corner

Matching engine kaise kaam karta hai?

Order book (bids + asks) in-memory rakho. Naya order aate hi opposite side se price-time priority pe match karo — pehle best price, phir pehle aaya order. Single-threaded rakho taaki deterministic rahe.

Stock exchange itni fast kyun hoti hai?

In-memory order book, single-threaded matching, colocation — microsecond latency chahiye kyunki HFT firms microseconds pe trade karti hain. Disk ya network hop yahan afford nahi hota.

Trade ke baad kya hota hai?

Clearing — kaun kisko kitna dega; settlement — T+1 din me paise aur shares transfer. Beech me risk checks aur circuit breakers market ko bachate hain.

Order ka 14-step safar — guide se

Order ke peeche ke components samajhne ke liye order ki zindagi ko trading flow se trace karo — ye critical path hai, strict latency requirements ke saath. Sab kuch fast hona chahiye:

  1. Step 1: client broker ki web ya mobile app se order place karta hai.
  2. Step 2: broker order exchange ko bhejta hai.
  3. Step 3: order client gateway se exchange me enter karta hai. Client gateway basic gatekeeping karta hai — input validation, rate limiting, authentication, normalization, etc. — phir order ko order manager ko forward karta hai.
  4. Steps 4–5: order manager risk checks karta hai, risk manager ke set kiye gaye rules ke hisaab se.
  5. Step 6: risk checks pass hone ke baad order manager verify karta hai ki wallet me order ke liye sufficient funds hain.
  6. Steps 7–9: order matching engine ko bheja jaata hai. Match milte hi matching engine 2 executions emit karta hai — buy side aur sell side ke liye ek-ek. Matching results replay pe deterministic rahein, isliye orders aur executions dono sequenced hote hain.
  7. Steps 10–14: executions client ko return hoti hain.

Note karo: trading flow (steps 1–14) critical path pe hai, jabki market data flow aur reporting flow critical path pe nahi hain — unki latency requirements alag hain.

8. Quick check

Q1. Order match karne ka rule kya hai?

  • Jo pehle aaya, wo pehle — price se farak nahi
  • Price-time priority — pehle best price, phir pehle aaya order — sahi jawab
  • Random

Q2. Matching engine single-threaded kyun hota hai?

  • Slow chalane ke liye
  • Taaki deterministic rahe — koi race condition na ho, har order ek sequence me process ho — sahi jawab
  • Paise bachane ke liye
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: Order book, price-time priority, in-memory single-threaded matching — microsecond me trade, aur settlement T+1 me. Yehi stock exchange hai.

15How It Works · 15 / 18

How are Notifications Pushed to Our Phones or PCs?

Tumhare phone pe notification aati hai — “Seema ne message bheja” — jabki WhatsApp khula bhi nahi hai. Ye kaise hota hai? Peeche hai push notification system: FCM/APNs, persistent connections, aur device tokens. Ye page batata hai notification tumhare phone tak kaise pahunchti hai, aur 2 billion phones pe ek saath kaise bheji jaati hai.

1. How are Notifications Pushed to Our Phones or PCs? — pehle ek simple kahani

Socho tumhare ghar ke bahar ek dakiya khada hai (persistent connection). Koi khat aaye to wo turant darwaza khatkhatata hai — tumhe post office jaane ki zaroorat nahi. Push notification wahi dakiya hai — server ko tumhare phone tak pahunchne ke liye ek hamesha khuli hui line chahiye hoti hai.

2. Gehrai me — tabs me samjho

1. Push kaise kaam karta hai — FCM/APNs

Phone pe Google (FCM) ya Apple (APNs) ka ek persistent connection hamesha khula rehta hai. App install hote hi phone ko ek device token milta hai (unique address). Server notification bhejna chahe to FCM/APNs ko bhejta hai token ke saath, aur wo use sahi phone tak pahuncha deta hai. App khula ho ya band — notification aa jaayegi.

Example: WhatsApp server → FCM → tumhara phone — 'Seema ne message bheja'.

Sahi: FCM/APNs use karo — khud har phone se connection rakhna impossible hai.
Galat: app ka apna persistent connection har phone se — battery aur scale dono maregi.

2. Device tokens aur topics

Har device ka token unique hota hai — token badal bhi sakta hai (app reinstall, OS update), isliye server ko token refresh handle karna padta hai. Topics se ek saath lakhon ko bhejo — subscribe('cricket') karo, phir ek message saare subscribers ko. Token invalid ho to use DB se hatao, nahi to FCM error dega.

Example: IPL score update — topic 'ipl' pe ek message, 5 crore phones pe notification.

Sahi: topics se broadcast, tokens se personal message.
Galat: invalid tokens ko baar-baar bhejna — FCM tumhe rate-limit kar dega.

3. Notification ke types aur priority

Data message: sirf data, app khud decide kare notification dikhani hai ya nahi. Notification message: FCM khud dikhata hai. Priority: high (chat message — turant) vs normal (promo — battery bachake, kabhi bhi). Collapse key: 10 messages aayein to sirf aakhri dikhao (jaise '5 naye messages'). TTL: phone offline ho to kitni der tak rakhein.

Example: OTP high priority (turant), 'Sale hai!' normal priority (der se bhi chalega).

Sahi: chat/OTP high priority, marketing normal — warna users notification band kar denge.
Galat: har promo high priority — battery khaayega, users naraz honge.

4. Scale — arabon notifications

Scale pe: fan-out service — ek event se lakhon tokens nikalo (sharded DB), batch send FCM ko (1000 tokens ek request me), retry with backoff (FCM down ho to), aur rate limiting (ek user ko 1 min me 10 notifications nahi). Delivery tracking — kaunsi notification dikhi, kaunsi click hui (analytics).

Example: Diwali sale — 10 crore users ko ek saath notification — fan-out + batching bina system marega.

Sahi: batching + sharding + backoff — scale ka mantra.
Galat: ek-ek karke bhejna — 10 crore requests, ghante lag jaayenge.

3. Aur gehrai me — details, numbers aur code

Push flow — ek notification ka safar

StepKya hota hai
1Event hua — Seema ne message bheja
2App server ne Rahul ka device token DB se nikala
3Request FCM/APNs ko bheji (token + message + priority)
4FCM ne persistent connection se phone tak pahunchaya
5Phone ne notification dikhayi (app band ho tab bhi)

Web push vs mobile push

Mobile: FCM (Android) / APNs (iOS) — OS level connection
Web:    Web Push API + Service Worker — browser band ho
        tab bhi (browser chalu ho to)
Email:  SMTP — slow, par universal
SMS:    Telecom — costly, par OTP ke liye best

4. Try karo — notification bhejo, dekho kahan atakti hai

Seema ne Rahul ko message bheja. Scenarios dabao — online, offline, topic broadcast — dekho notification kaise pahunchti hai.

  1. Rahul online hai, app band hai
  2. Rahul ka phone offline hai
  3. IPL score — 5 crore phones ko ek saath
  4. Promo spam — user naraz

5. Comparison — ek table me

ChannelSpeedCostKab
Push (FCM/APNs)SecondsFreeApp users
SMSSeconds₹0.15/msgOTP, no app
EmailMinutesCheapReceipts, digests
Web pushSecondsFreeBrowser users

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

  • Token refresh ignore karna — purane token pe bhejte raho, delivery zero.
  • Har notification high priority — battery + user narazgi.
  • Bina batching ke broadcast — crore requests, system down.
  • Collapse key na use karna — user ko 50 notifications ek saath.
  • Delivery track na karna — pata hi nahi notification pahunchi ya nahi.

7. Interview corner

Push notification phone tak kaise pahunchti hai jab app band ho?

OS level persistent connection se — Android pe FCM, iOS pe APNs. App server notification FCM/APNs ko bhejta hai device token ke saath, aur wo use phone tak pahuncha deta hai, app khula ho ya band.

5 crore users ko ek saath notification kaise bhejoge?

Topics + fan-out + batching: topic pe ek publish, fan-out service tokens nikaale (sharded DB), FCM ko 1000 tokens per request batch me bhejo. Ek-ek karke bhejna impossible hai.

Device token kya hai aur kyun badalta hai?

Har device+app ka unique address hai. App reinstall, OS update ya data clear pe badal jaata hai — isliye server ko token refresh handle karna padta hai aur invalid tokens hataane padte hain.

FCM ke 7 steps — guide se

Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) ek cross-platform messaging solution hai — notifications ko reliably compose, send, queue aur route kar sakta hai. Ye message senders (app servers) aur receivers (client apps) ke beech unified API deta hai. App developer isse user retention badha sakta hai.

  1. Steps 1–2: client app pehli baar start hoti hai to FCM ko credentials bhejti hai — Sender ID, API Key aur App ID. FCM client app instance ke liye Registration Token generate karta hai (ise Instance ID bhi kehte hain). Ye token har notification me include hona chahiye.
  2. Step 3: client app Registration Token app server ko bhejti hai. App server token ko aage ki communication ke liye cache karta hai. Time ke saath tokens bahut ho jaate hain, isliye recommended practice hai token ko timestamps ke saath store karna aur stale tokens ko time-time pe remove karna.
  3. Step 4: messages bhejne ke 2 tareeke hain — console GUI me seedha compose karo (Step 4.1), ya app server se bhejo (Step 4.2). Baad wale ke liye Firebase Admin SDK ya HTTP use kar sakte ho.
  4. Step 5: FCM messages receive karta hai, aur devices offline hon to messages ko storage me queue kar deta hai.
  5. Step 6: FCM messages ko platform-level transport ko forward karta hai. Ye transport layer platform-specific configurations handle karta hai.
  6. Step 7: messages targeted devices tak route hote hain. Notifications app server ki bheji gayi configurations ke hisaab se display hoti hain.

8. Quick check

Q1. App band ho tab bhi notification kaise aati hai?

  • App background me chalti rehti hai
  • FCM/APNs ka OS-level persistent connection phone tak pahunchata hai — sahi jawab
  • SMS se

Q2. 5 crore logon ko ek saath notification bhejne ke liye kya use hota hai?

  • Ek-ek karke loop me bhejna
  • Topics + fan-out + batching (1000 tokens/request) — sahi jawab
  • Sabko email bhejna
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: Device token address hai, FCM/APNs dakiya hai, aur fan-out + batching se arabon phones pe ek saath notification jaati hai.

16How It Works · 16 / 18

What Happens When You Upload a File to Amazon S3?

Tumne Amazon S3 pe ek photo upload ki — 2 second me duniya bhar se dikhne lagi. Peeche kya hota hai? Upload ka flow: presigned URL, multipart upload, replication, aur 11 nines durability. Ye page batata hai ek file S3 me jaake kaise kabhi nahi khoti.

1. What Happens When You Upload a File to Amazon S3? — pehle ek simple kahani

Socho tum ek badi library me kitaab jama kar rahe ho. Pehle reception pe token lo (presigned URL), phir kitaab ko hisso me baant ke alag-alag almariyon me rakho (multipart + replication), aur har hisse ki 3 copies alag-alag kamron me (durability). Ek kamre me aag lag jaaye to bhi kitaab safe hai.

2. Gehrai me — tabs me samjho

1. Upload ka flow — presigned URL

Browser seedha S3 pe upload nahi karta — pehle tumhara app server S3 se ek presigned URL leta hai (time-limited, sirf is file ke liye permission). Browser us URL pe file bhejta hai — server ke beech me aaye bina, isliye server pe load nahi. Badi file ho to multipart upload — 5MB ke hisso me baanto, parallel bhejo, ek hissa fail ho to sirf wo dobara bhejo.

Example: 1GB video — 200 parts, parallel upload, ek part fail hua to sirf wo retry.

Sahi: presigned URL + multipart — server free, upload fast aur resumable.
Galat: file pehle app server pe, phir S3 pe — server bandwidth aur time dono waste.

2. Durability — 11 nines ka matlab

S3 har object ko multiple facilities (AZs) me replicate karta hai — kam se kam 3 copies, alag-alag buildings me. 11 nines durability (99.999999999%) ka matlab: 10 lakh objects me se saal me ek bhi khone ki probability bahut kam hai. Checksum se corruption pakda jaata hai — ek copy kharab hui to doosri se repair.

Example: ek poora data centre doob jaaye to bhi tumhari file safe — copies alag AZ me hain.

Sahi: versioning on rakho — galti se delete/overwrite ho to purana version wapas.
Galat: “S3 pe hai to backup ki zaroorat nahi” — delete aur ransomware se versioning + MFA delete bachata hai.

3. Storage classes — sasta kaise rakhein

S3 me classes hain: Standard (bar-baar access), Intelligent-Tiering (khud decide kare), Standard-IA (kabhi-kabhi), Glacier (archive — retrieve me ghante), Deep Archive (saal me ek baar). Lifecycle policy se file apne aap sasti class me jaati hai — 30 din baad IA, 90 din baad Glacier.

Example: user ki purani photos — 1 saal baad Glacier me, bill 80% kam.

Sahi: lifecycle policy din 1 se — bill apne aap kam hota rahega.
Galat: sab kuch Standard me — 5 saal purana backup bhi mehenge rate pe.

4. CDN, security, aur consistency

CloudFront (CDN) ke saath file edge se milti hai — fast, aur S3 pe load kam. Security: bucket policy + IAM — public sirf jo chahiye wo, baaki private; encryption at rest (SSE) aur transit (HTTPS). Consistency: S3 ab strong read-after-write deta hai — upload ke turant baad read karo to nayi file milegi (pehle eventual thi).

Example: profile photo upload ke turant baad dikhni chahiye — strong consistency se milegi.

Sahi: private bucket + presigned URL — public bucket sirf static website ke liye.
Galat: bucket public aur usme sensitive files — data leak ka sabse common reason.

3. Aur gehrai me — details, numbers aur code

Upload flow — step by step

StepKya hota hai
1Browser app server se presigned URL maangta hai
2Server S3 se time-limited URL banata hai (PUT, is file ke liye)
3Browser file ko parts me baant ke seedha S3 pe bhejta hai
4S3 parts ko jodta hai, checksum verify karta hai
5Object 3 AZs me replicate — 11 nines durable
6CDN edge pe cache — duniya bhar se fast

Multipart upload — code jaisa

# 1GB file, 5MB parts = 200 parts
upload_id = s3.create_multipart_upload(bucket, key)
for part in parts:  # parallel me bhejo
    s3.upload_part(upload_id, part)
s3.complete_multipart_upload(upload_id)  # jodo
# Ek part fail? Sirf wo dobara bhejo — poori file nahi.

4. Try karo — 1GB video upload karo

Tum 1GB ka video S3 pe upload kar rahe ho. Steps dabao — dekho multipart, replication aur CDN kya karte hain.

  1. 1. Presigned URL lo
  2. 2. Multipart upload — 200 parts
  3. 3. Replication — 3 copies
  4. 4. Duniya bhar se access

5. Comparison — ek table me

Storage classAccessCostRetrieve time
StandardBar-baarHighms
Intelligent-TieringAutoMediumms
Standard-IAKabhi-kabhiLowms
GlacierRareVery lowHours
Deep ArchiveSaal me ek baarLowest12+ hours

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

  • File app server se hoke bhejna — presigned URL use karo.
  • Badi file ek hi request me — fail hui to poori dobara; multipart use karo.
  • Bucket public chhodna — sensitive data leak.
  • Versioning off rakhna — galti se delete hua to wapas nahi.
  • Lifecycle policy na lagana — purana data mehenge rate pe pada rahega.

7. Interview corner

S3 pe file upload ka flow kya hai?

App server presigned URL deta hai, browser file ko multipart (5MB parts) me baant ke seedha S3 pe bhejta hai. S3 parts jodta hai, checksum check karta hai, aur 3 AZs me replicate karta hai.

11 nines durability ka matlab?

Data khone ki probability lagbhag zero — S3 har object ki copies multiple facilities me rakhta hai, checksum se corruption pakadta hai aur repair karta hai. Par ye durability hai — delete se bachne ke liye versioning chahiye.

Multipart upload kyun?

Badi file ek request me bhejo to fail hone pe poori dobara bhejni padegi. Parts me baanto to parallel upload fast hota hai, fail hua part hi retry hota hai, aur pause/resume bhi possible hai.

Guide ke terms + 7-step upload flow

Pehle terms define kar lein:

  • Bucket: objects ka logical container. Bucket name globally unique hota hai. S3 pe data upload karne ke liye pehle bucket banana zaroori hai.
  • Object: bucket me store hone wala individual piece of data. Isme object data (payload — bytes ka koi bhi sequence) aur metadata (name-value pairs jo object ko describe karte hain) hota hai.
  • S3 object 2 cheezon se banta hai: Metadata — mutable hai, attributes jaise ID, bucket name, object name; Object data — immutable hai, actual data. Object bucket me rehta hai, path aisa dikhta hai: /bucket-to-share/script.txt. Bucket ke paas sirf metadata hota hai; object ke paas metadata + actual data dono.

Example: pehle bucket bucket-to-share banao, phir file script.txt upload karo:

  1. Client HTTP PUT request bhejta hai bucket bucket-to-share banane ke liye. Request API service ko forward hoti hai.
  2. API service IAM (Identity and Access Management) ko call karta hai — user authorized hai aur WRITE permission hai ya nahi.
  3. API service metadata store ko call karke metadata database me bucket info ki entry banata hai. Entry banne ke baad client ko success message milta hai.
  4. Bucket banne ke baad client HTTP PUT request bhejta hai object script.txt banane ke liye.
  5. API service user ki identity verify karta hai aur bucket pe WRITE permission ensure karta hai.
  6. Validation pass hone ke baad API service object data (HTTP PUT payload) ko data store ko bhejta hai. Data store payload ko object ke roop me persist karta hai aur object ka UUID return karta hai.
  7. API service metadata store ko call karke metadata database me nayi entry banata hai — object_id (UUID), bucket_id (kis bucket ka object hai), object_name, etc.

8. Quick check

Q1. Badi file upload karte waqt fail hone pe poori file dobara kyun nahi bhejni padti?

  • S3 yaad rakhta hai
  • Multipart upload — sirf fail hua part retry hota hai — sahi jawab
  • File chhoti ho jaati hai

Q2. S3 ki 11 nines durability kaise milti hai?

  • Ek bahut bada server
  • Har object ki copies multiple AZs/facilities me replicate hoti hain — sahi jawab
  • File compress karke
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: Presigned URL se seedha upload, multipart se fast aur resumable, 3 AZs me replication se 11 nines — aur CDN se duniya bhar me fast.

← Previous15 · How are Notifications Pushed to Our Phones or PCs?Next →17 · Proximity Service
17How It Works · 17 / 18

Proximity Service

“Paas ke dost kaun hai?” — Tinder, Uber, ya Facebook ka “nearby friends” — ye sab Proximity Service hai: location update karo, paas wale log dhoondho, aur real-time me dikhao. Challenge: arabon locations, har second update, aur millisecond me nearby search.

1. Proximity Service — pehle ek simple kahani

Socho ek bade mele me sabke paas ek GPS wala badge hai. Tum poochho “mere 100 meter me kaun hai” — to system ko poore mele ke 1 lakh logon ko check nahi karna, bas tumhare aas-paas wale hisse ko dekhna hai. Proximity service wahi hissa nikaalne ka tareeka hai.

2. Gehrai me — tabs me samjho

1. Location kaise store hoti hai — Geohash / S2

Har location (lat/long) ko geohash ya S2 cell me convert karo — ek string/ID jo area ko represent karti hai. Paas ki jagah ka prefix same hota hai — isliye “paas” dhoondhna matlab same prefix wale records dhoondhna. Location Redis (GEO commands) ya DB me geohash index pe store hoti hai.

Example: geohash u4pruyd — pehle 5 characters same hon to ~5km ke andar ho.

Sahi: geohash/S2 — nearby search ko prefix search me badal do.
Galat: lat/long ko float columns me rakh ke har query pe distance nikaalna.

2. Location updates — har second?

User chalta hai to location badalti hai — par har second update karoge to server marega. Solution: significant change pe hi update (100m chale to), ya throttled (30 sec me ek baar). Redis GEOADD se location update hoti hai, TTL se purani location expire hoti hai (offline user gayab).

Example: Uber driver 10 sec me ek baar location bhejta hai — rider ko live dikhta hai, server pe load manageable hai.

Sahi: update tabhi jab location badli ho — battery aur server dono bachte hain.
Galat: har second update — 1M users = 1M writes/sec, DB marega.

3. Nearby query — kaise fast hoti hai

Query: “2km ke andar kaun hai?” Redis GEORADIUS ya DB me geohash prefix + exact distance filter — pehle coarse (aaspass ke cells), phir exact (Haversine distance). Quadtree bhi use hota hai. Result distance se sort karke do, limit lagao (top 50).

Example: 1M users me se 2km wale 30 — sirf aas-paas wale cells check hue, poora data nahi.

Sahi: coarse filter + exact distance — do-step search.
Galat: saare users ki distance nikaal ke sort karna.

4. Privacy aur scale

Privacy: exact location kabhi share mat karo — approximate (500m grid) ya opt-in (user ne allow kiya tabhi). Location data encrypt karo, retention kam rakho. Scale: duniya ko geohash prefix se shard karo — alag area, alag server. Hotspots (jaise stadium) pe alag handling — wahan density bahut zyada hoti hai.

Example: Tinder exact location nahi batata — sirf distance (“2 km door”).

Sahi: approximate location + opt-in — privacy pehle.
Galat: exact lat/long sabko dikhana — stalking ka risk.

3. Aur gehrai me — details, numbers aur code

Proximity service — blocks

BlockKaamTech
Location ingestUpdates lenaAPI + throttling
Geo indexNearby searchRedis GEO / S2 / geohash
ShardArea-wise baantnaGeohash prefix
Privacy layerExact location chhupanaGrid rounding, opt-in

Redis GEO — commands

GEOADD drivers 77.20 28.61 driver123   # location update
GEORADIUS drivers 77.20 28.61 2 km     # 2km ke andar kaun?
  WITHDIST ASC COUNT 10                # distance ke saath, top 10
GEODIST drivers driver123 driver456 km  # do ke beech distance

4. Try karo — paas ke driver dhoondho (Uber style)

Tumhe cab chahiye. Buttons dabao — dekho drivers ki location kaise update hoti hai aur sabse paas wala kaise milta hai.

  1. Drivers ki location update
  2. Tumne cab book ki — CP se
  3. Driver tumhari taraf aa raha hai
  4. Stadium hotspot — 50,000 log ek jagah!

5. Comparison — ek table me

MethodBest forWeakness
Redis GEOReal-time, medium scaleMemory, single region
Geohash in DBLarge scale, persistentBoundary problem
S2 cellsGoogle scaleComplex
QuadtreeIn-memory searchSkewed data

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

  • Har second location update — server aur battery dono maregi.
  • Exact location sabko dikhana — privacy risk, approximate dikhao.
  • Brute-force distance — saare users check karna kabhi scale nahi hoga.
  • TTL na rakhna — offline users hamesha 'paas' dikhenge.
  • Hotspot ignore karna — stadium jaise dense areas pe system atak jaata hai.

7. Interview corner

Nearby drivers kaise dhoondhte ho — Uber style?

Location ko geohash/S2 me convert karo, Redis GEO ya spatial index me rakho. Query pe aas-paas ke cells me search karo (GEORADIUS), phir exact distance se sort karo. Poora data scan nahi karte.

Location updates kitni baar bhejni chahiye?

Har second nahi — significant change (100m) ya throttled (10-30 sec) pe. Isse server load aur battery dono bachte hain, aur real-time feel bhi bana rehta hai.

Privacy kaise handle karte ho?

Exact lat/long kabhi share nahi karte — approximate distance (500m grid) dikhate hain, opt-in lete hain, aur location data ka retention kam rakhte hain.

Guide ka geohash — bits aur SQL

2 key services hain: Business Service — restaurant information add/delete/update karo; customers restaurant details dekhte hain. Location-based Service (LBS) — radius aur location do, paas ke restaurants ki list lo.

Restaurant locations database me kaise store karein taaki LBS paas ke restaurants efficiently return kare? Latitude aur longitude store karke har restaurant se distance calculate karna bahut inefficient hai. Geohash algorithm se search fast hoti hai.

  • Pehle planet ko prime meridian aur equator ke saath 4 quadrants me baanto: Latitude [-90, 0] ko 0 se, [0, 90] ko 1 se represent karo; Longitude [-180, 0] ko 0 se, [0, 180] ko 1 se represent karo.
  • Phir har grid ko 4 chhote grids me baanto. Har grid ko longitude bit aur latitude bit alternate karke represent karo.

Red-highlighted grid ke paas ke restaurants dhoondhne ke liye SQL aisi likho: SELECT * FROM geohash_index WHERE geohash LIKE '01%'

Geohash ki limitation: ek grid me bahut saare restaurants ho sakte hain (downtown New York), doosre me ek bhi nahi (ocean) — isliye process optimize karne ke liye aur complex algorithms hain.

8. Quick check

Q1. Paas ke log dhoondhne ke liye location ko kis form me store karte hain?

  • Plain lat/long float columns
  • Geohash / S2 cell — paas ki jagah ka prefix same hota hai — sahi jawab
  • City ka naam

Q2. Driver har second location kyun nahi bhejta?

  • GPS kharab hai
  • Significant change ya throttled update se server load aur battery bachti hai — sahi jawab
  • Uber ko pata nahi
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: Location ko geohash banao, Redis GEO me rakho, significant change pe update karo, aur nearby search me sirf aas-paas wale cells check karo.

18How It Works · 18 / 18

How Do Search Engines Work?

Tum Google pe “best pizza near me” type karte ho — 0.5 second me arabon pages me se 10 results. Peeche hai crawling, indexing, aur ranking ka system. Ye page batata hai search engine kaise kaam karta hai — spider se lekar PageRank tak.

1. How Do Search Engines Work? — pehle ek simple kahani

Socho ek bahut badi library hai — arabon kitaabein. Ek librarian (crawler) har kitaab ko padh ke ek index register banata hai — kaunsa shabd kaunsi kitaab me hai. Tum poochho “pizza” to wo register dekh ke turant bata deta hai — poori library chhaan ne ki zaroorat nahi.

2. Gehrai me — tabs me samjho

1. Crawling — web ko chhaanna

Crawler (spider) seed URLs se shuru karta hai, page download karta hai, usme se links nikaalta hai, aur unhe queue me daalta hai. Politeness — ek site ko bahut fast crawl mat karo (robots.txt padho, delay rakho). Freshness — news sites roz, purani sites mahine me ek baar. Dedup — same page dobara crawl mat karo (URL normalization + content hash).

Example: google.com se shuru karo — uske links se lakhon pages, unke links se arabon pages.

Sahi: crawl budget — important pages pehle, spam sites ko kam priority.
Galat: bina delay ke crawl karna — site down kar doge, block ho jaoge.

2. Indexing — inverted index

Har page ko parse karo — words nikaalo, stemming karo (running → run), stop words hatao. Phir inverted index banao: word → kaunse pages me hai (doc IDs + positions). Index sharded hota hai (term-wise ya doc-wise), aur compressed rehta hai. Yehi index search ko fast banata hai.

Example: 'pizza' word 5 crore pages me hai — index se turant list mil jaati hai.

Sahi: inverted index — search ka dil hai.
Galat: har query pe saare pages scan karna — kabhi khatam nahi hoga.

3. Ranking — kaunsa result pehle?

Relevance: TF-IDF / BM25 — query words page me kitni baar aur kitne rare hain. Authority: PageRank — kitne achhe pages is page ko link karte hain. Freshness, location, personalization bhi matter karte hain. Aaj ML models (RankBrain, BERT) query ka matlab samajhte hain — sirf keywords nahi.

Example: 'pizza near me' — relevance + tumhari location + page authority — teeno milke ranking banti hai.

Sahi: relevance + authority + freshness — teeno ka balance.
Galat: sirf keyword count — keyword stuffing wale jeet jaayenge.

4. Query serving — 0.5 sec me kaise?

Query aate hi: parse karo (spell correct, synonyms), index shards se candidates nikalo (parallel), rank karo (top 1000 → top 10), snippets banao, aur cache karo (popular queries ka result ready rakho). Spell correction aur autocomplete alag services hain.

Example: 'best pizza' — 100 shards parallel, har ek top 10 bhejta hai, phir final ranking.

Sahi: sharding + caching — popular queries milliseconds me.
Galat: ek hi server pe saara index — query aate hi marega.

3. Aur gehrai me — details, numbers aur code

Search engine pipeline

StageKaamTech
CrawlPages download karoDistributed crawlers, frontier queue
ParseWords + links nikaloHTML parser, dedup
IndexWord → pagesInverted index, sharded
RankBest pehleBM25, PageRank, ML
Serve0.5 sec me jawabParallel shards + cache

PageRank — ek line me

Page ka rank = usko link karne wale pages ke rank ka sum
  (achhe page ka link zyada keemti)
Formula: PR(A) = (1-d) + d * sum(PR(T) / links(T))
  d = damping factor (~0.85)

4. Try karo — search engine chalao

Tum search engine ho. Ek query aayi hai — steps dabao aur dekho crawling se lekar ranking tak kya hota hai.

  1. 1. Crawl karo
  2. 2. Index banao
  3. 3. Query aayi: 'best pizza near me'
  4. 4. Spam site ko pakdo

5. Comparison — ek table me

Google scaleChhota search (blog)
Pages100B+1000s
IndexSharded, distributedEk inverted index
RankingML + PageRankTF-IDF kaafi
CrawlContinuousEk baar

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

  • Crawl bina politeness ke — site down, IP block.
  • Index bina compression ke — storage phat jaayega.
  • Sirf keyword count se ranking — spam jeet jaayega.
  • Dedup na karna — same page 100 baar index.
  • Freshness ignore karna — 5 saal purani news top pe.

7. Interview corner

Search engine kaise kaam karta hai?

Teen stages: crawling (pages download karo), indexing (inverted index banao — word → pages), aur ranking (BM25 + PageRank + ML se best results pehle). Query aate hi shards parallel search karte hain.

Inverted index kya hai?

Har word se kaunse documents me hai, ye mapping. Search karte waqt poora data scan nahi karna padta — index se turant candidates mil jaate hain. Yehi search ko fast banata hai.

PageRank kya hai?

Ek page ka rank usko link karne wale pages ke rank pe depend karta hai — achhe page ka link zyada keemti hota hai. Isse authority measure hoti hai, sirf keyword count se spam nahi jeet sakta.

Serving ke 3 steps — guide se

Query aane pe search engine ka algorithm index me se sabse relevant aur helpful pages dhoondhta hai:

Serving Search Results

  • Query Analysis: search engine user ki query ka meaning aur intent samajhta hai — keywords pehchanna, synonyms samajhna, context interpret karna.
  • Retrieval: query analysis ke hisaab se vast index se relevant pages retrieve karta hai — query ke keywords ko web pages ke indexed content se match karke.
  • Ranking: retrieved pages ko relevance aur doosre factors ke hisaab se rank kiya jaata hai.

Crawling seeds se shuru hoti hai — known web pages ki list se, phir un pages ke links follow karke naye pages dhoondhte hain, aur content ka vast interconnected network banta hai.

8. Quick check

Q1. Search itni fast kaise hoti hai — arabon pages me se 0.5 sec me?

  • Har baar saare pages scan karke
  • Inverted index — word se pages ka pehle se bana index, sharded — sahi jawab
  • Cache me saare answers

Q2. PageRank kis cheez ko measure karta hai?

  • Page me kitne words hain
  • Page ki authority — kitne achhe pages use link karte hain — sahi jawab
  • Page kitna purana hai
Ek line me yaad rakh lo: Crawl karo, inverted index banao, BM25 + PageRank se rank karo — aur shards parallel chala ke 0.5 sec me jawab do.

Padhna ek baat hai, khud chala kar dekhna doosri. Neeche ke 4 labs me values badlo, button dabao, aur result turant dekho — yahi concepts interview me poochhe jate hain.

LAB 1Lab 1 / 4

Live update kaise? Polling vs SSE vs WebSocket

FAQ12 Interview FAQs

FAQs — interview me poochhe jaane wale sawal

Har sawal par click karo — jawab khul jayega. Ye sawal is part ke 18 guides se seedhe judte hain.

Q01 WhatsApp me message ka flow kya hai — offline user ko message kaise milta hai?
Sender message bhejti hai to pehle Chat Service A ko jaata hai, phir sequencing service unique ID deti hai aur message store me persist hota hai. Phir message sync queue se Receiver ki chat service ko sync hota hai. Sync service Receiver ki presence check karta hai — online hai to WebSocket se seedha Receiver tak, offline hai to push server ko bhejta hai aur Receiver ke device pe push notification aati hai. Receiver online aate hi message sync ho jaata hai, isliye message kabhi lose nahi hota.
Q02 Gmail me search itni fast kaise hoti hai — lakhon emails me se 2 second me?
Gmail har email ko index karta hai — inverted index me har word ke saamne us word wale emails ki list hoti hai. Search karte waqt poora mailbox scan nahi hota, sirf index me word dhoondha jaata hai. Attachments deduplicate hote hain — ek hi file lakhon logon ko mili ho to ek hi copy store hoti hai. Isliye search aur storage dono fast aur saste rehte hain.
Q03 Google Docs me do log ek saath edit karein to conflict kaise solve hota hai — OT vs CRDT?
Google Docs Operational Transformation (OT) use karta hai — server operations ko transform karke sabke document ko ek jaisa rakhta hai. CRDT ek aur tareeka hai — har operation aisa design hota hai ki kisi bhi order me apply karo, final document ek jaisa hi banta hai, bina central server ke. OT ko server chahiye, CRDT bina server bhi kaam karta hai, par CRDT ka metadata bada hota hai. Interview me dono ka trade-off bolna chahiye.
Q04 Live streaming me latency kam kaise rakhte hain — HLS vs RTMP me kya farak hai?
Live streaming ke steps hain: capture, compress/encode (H.264), segment, adaptive bitrate, CDN edge delivery, decode/play. RTMP low-latency ingest ke liye use hota hai (streamer se server tak), HLS/DASH viewers tak delivery ke liye — HLS Apple devices pe chalta hai, DASH nahi. Adaptive bitrate streaming har viewer ko uske network ke hisaab se quality deti hai, isliye video rukta nahi, quality kam ho jaati hai.
Q05 S3 pe 1GB file upload karte waqt fail ho jaye to kya hota hai — poori file dobara bhejni padti hai?
Nahi — multipart upload use hota hai. Badi file ko chhote parts me baant kar upload karo, har part ka alag ETag milta hai. Koi part fail ho to sirf wahi part dobara bhejo, poori file nahi. Upload complete hone pe S3 parts ko jod kar object bana deta hai. Isi liye S3 pe 11 nines durability milti hai — data multiple devices aur facilities me replicate hota hai.
Q06 Paas ke drivers ya restaurants dhoondhne ke liye geohash kaise kaam karta hai?
Geohash latitude/longitude ko ek chhoti string me badal deta hai — planet ko prime meridian aur equator se 4 quadrants me baant kar, phir har grid ko 4 chhote grids me. Paas ki jagah ka geohash prefix same hota hai, isliye SQL me LIKE '01%' se paas ke results mil jaate hain, har restaurant se distance calculate kiye bina. Limitation: downtown jaise dense jagah me ek grid overflow ho jaata hai, ocean me khaali rehta hai — isliye quadtree kabhi behtar hota hai.
Q07 Push notification phone tak kaise pahunchti hai jab app band ho — FCM kya karta hai?
Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) cross-platform solution hai. App pehli baar start hote hi FCM ko Sender ID, API Key aur App ID bhejti hai, aur FCM ek Registration Token (Instance ID) deta hai. App server token ko store karta hai aur FCM ko message bhejta hai — FCM use queue karta hai (device offline ho to), phir platform-level transport (APNs/Android) se device tak pahunchata hai. App band ho tab bhi OS notification dikhata hai.
Q08 Quadtree kya hai aur geohash se behtar kab hota hai?
Quadtree ek in-memory data structure hai jo 2D space ko recursively 4 quadrants me baant-ta hai, jab tak har leaf me 100 se zyada businesses na rahein. Nearby search root se leaf tak traverse karke hoti hai. Geohash se behtar tab hota hai jab density uneven ho — downtown me geohash ka ek grid overflow ho jaata hai, quadtree dense jagah pe khud ko chhote hisso me baant leta hai. Kamzori: 200 million businesses ke saath build karne me minutes lagte hain, aur build hote waqt server traffic serve nahi kar sakta — isliye incremental rollout zaroori hai.
Q09 Email deliver hone me MUA, MTA aur MDA ka kya role hai?
MUA (Mail User Agent) Outlook/Gmail jaisa client hai — sender email likh kar Sender Mail Server ko bhejta hai. MTA (Mail Transmission Agent) email ko relay karta hai, SMTP protocol se ek server se doosre server tak. MDA (Mail Delivery Agent) Receiver Mail Server pe email ko receiver ke mailbox me store karta hai. Receiver apne MUA se POP3 ya IMAP se email fetch karta hai. Snail mail se yaad rakho: MUA mailbox, MTA post office, MDA dost ka mailbox.
Q10 Google Maps routing kaise karta hai — ETA kaise nikalta hai?
Google Maps ke 3 components hain: Location Service (har kuch seconds me user location update — naye/band roads aur live traffic ke liye), Map Rendering (duniya tiles me banti hai, CDN+S3 se serve hoti hai, zoom ke liye pre-calculated tiles), Navigation Service (Geocoding Service address ko lat/long me badalta hai, Route Planner top-K shortest paths nikaal kar current traffic aur historical data se har path ka time estimate karta hai, phir rank karta hai). 2005 me shuru hua, March 2021 tak 1 billion daily users aur 99% coverage thi.
Q11 Payment system me idempotency kyun zaroori hai — ek hi payment do baar cut jaye to?
Network retry ya double-click se ek hi payment request do baar aa sakti hai. Idempotency key har payment request ke saath bheji jaati hai — pehli baar process hone pe key store ho jaati hai, dobara wahi key aaye to system naya payment nahi karta, purana result return kar deta hai. Isi liye payment flow me wallet update aur ledger entry ek saath, atomic tareeke se hote hain — paise kabhi do baar nahi kat-te.
Q12 Search engine query aate hi 0.5 second me results kaise deta hai — arabon pages me se?
Teen processes: Crawling — crawlers seed pages se shuru karke links follow karte hain aur web pages download karte hain. Indexing — pages ko analyze karke inverted index banaya jaata hai (keywords, content type, freshness, language). Serving — query aate hi Query Analysis (meaning, synonyms, context), Retrieval (index se relevant pages), Ranking (relevance ke hisaab se order). Query time pe poora web scan nahi hota — sirf pehle se bana index dhoondha jaata hai, isliye 0.5 second me jawab milta hai.

Scope se bahar kya hai — imaandaari se

  • Baaki parts ke guides isme nahi hain: System Design 101 ke baaki parts (jaise Basics, Storage, Scaling) ke guides alag parts me hain — yahan sirf “How It Works” ke 18 guides hain.
  • Live systems nahi: ye guides ka flow samjhate hain — Gmail, WhatsApp ya S3 ka asli live demo ya API yahan nahi chalta; labs me chhote hisse simulate kiye gaye hain.
  • Production code nahi: code snippets aur flows samajhne ke liye hain, production me seedhe copy-paste karne ke liye nahi — har system ke trade-offs apne context ke hisaab se badalte hain.
  • Har guide ka har edge case nahi: jo flow guide me diya gaya tha, wahi poora diya gaya hai; uske bahar ke rare edge cases (jaise region-specific compliance) isme nahi hain.
